#### _**[Mitch McConnell's latest appearance is another disturbing reminder of how broken Washington has become. Politicians cling to power, their parties protect them, and the American people are left without the representation they deserve. At Endless Urgency, we're fighting to expose that dysfunction, hold both parties accountable, and push for the generational change our democracy desperately needs. This is exactly why independent media matters, especially right now. * * *
Hey folks,
What we're watching happen with Mitch McConnell is genuinely disturbing. And frankly, it's a perfect example of everything that's broken about Washington.
A sitting United States senator can't answer basic questions from reporters, his staff keeps pretending everything is fine, and the political establishment just looks the other way. This isn't just about Mitch McConnell. It's about a generation of politicians refusing to let go of power, even when the people they're supposed to represent are paying the price.
And it's time we had a serious conversation about it.
Here's what we're digging into:
* [**00:00:54**] Why Mitch McConnell's latest appearance raises serious questions about his ability to serve, and why America's gerontocracy problem can no longer be ignored.
* [**00:03:24**] The people of Kentucky deserve real representation. We break down the failures of accountability in both parties and why age limits, term limits, and transparency matter.
* [**00:06:27**] A generational shift is coming to Congress. We look at what the midterm elections mean for younger leadership and why Washington desperately needs new voices.
* [**00:09:34**] Democrats are beginning to confront their aging leadership problem, while Republicans remain stuck with Donald Trump and Mitch McConnell as the faces of their party.
* [**00:12:08**] It's time for generational change. Why both parties need to stop protecting politicians who refuse to step aside and start putting the American people first.

Look, this isn't about being cruel to older politicians. It's about dignity, accountability, and whether our democracy actually works for the people it's supposed to serve. We need leaders who are present, capable, and ready to fight for our future. And we need independent voices willing to say what Washington insiders won't. That's what we're building at Endless Urgency, and if you believe this country deserves better than the same broken political establishment, I hope you'll help us keep fighting.

With urgency,
--Mike

### What’s next for Jonny Larsen for Congress?
---
|
---
| | First, thank you to our supporters and voters. This process only works when candidates earn the trust of the public, and we're incredibly grateful to everyone who put their faith in Jonny and this campaign.
I'm happy to report that I've already updated my FEC Form 2 to reflect my **2028 run for Congress!**
The nationwide blue wave didn't skip Utah. There were several Democratic wins in the 4th Congressional District, including **Jess Birtcher** , who defeated anti-union Jordan Teuscher, and fellow veterans **Shana Anderson** in Senate District 19 and **Drew Howells** in House District 39. Many other Democrats also came remarkably close to victory, performing much better than predicted.
The entire state moved to the left, and we're optimistic that this progress will continue. Take a look below at how Jonny's share of the vote compares with previous Democratic candidates in today's 4th Congressional District. He outperformed every one of them, including candidates running in much more favorable election cycles. If this isn't a motivating factor, we'd like to know what is! Check out the graphic below.
**Stay involved!** We'll continue sending occasional campaign emails with events, updates, and opportunities to participate. body:

Peter, just weeks
before Election Day, Donald Trump’s DHS agents raided Ilhan’s home in a
blatant attempt to intimidate her.

Now Trump’s administration is trying to strip Ilhan of the citizenship
she’s held for more than 25 years, using claims that have been debunked
again and again.

This is the latest escalation in Trump’s relentless revenge campaign
against Ilhan.

Why? Because Ilhan stands up for working people and refuses to back down.
In coming after her, Trump has put Ilhan, our Squad, and the people and
communities they love and represent in danger.

Trump’s playbook is simple: use fear to shut down progressive power. He’s
trying to make an example out of the Squad so no one else dares to speak
up.

But we know what this movement is made of, and we won’t be intimidated.
With threats this serious, security isn’t optional. It’s what lets our
Squad keep fighting in Congress.

We refuse to let Ilhan face these attacks alone, and we’re counting on
grassroots supporters like you to step up. We’re halfway through the
month, and we need to stay on pace to make sure the Squad has the security
they need to stay safe and unapologetically fearless in the halls of
Congress.

body:
Let’s stand with the folks we helped elect and give more working people a shot at making a difference.
#
Peter,
When we started Small Town PAC, we had a pretty simple idea: Find and support good people who know their communities, understand what their neighbors are up against, _and will fight like hell for them._

Tim

Peter,
Do you believe in the power of prayer?
My name’s Troy Downing. When America faced its darkest hour after 9/11, I knew I couldn't just sit on the sidelines. I enlisted in the U.S. Air Force and served eight years in a Combat Search and Rescue squadron, deploying twice to Afghanistan.
On those missions, flying into danger to rescue wounded soldiers, you rely on something much bigger than yourself. Through every deployment and dark night, God’s guiding hand was our shield and protection.
Now, as a Member of Congress working to defend the American Dream and put Americans FIRST, the battlefield has changed, but the spiritual stakes are just as high. **I still rely on that same guiding hand every single day.**
[ If you believe in God and the power of prayer to guide our leaders and protect our land, I am humbly asking you to lend me your thoughts and prayers today.](https://trk.emails.troydowning._)

Troy Downing

## Florida Releases Voter Fraud Defendant List
Florida Attorney General James Uthmeier's office [released the names of all 20 people](https://email.editor.joinflyoverflorida.com/c/eJykkL1u4zAQhJ9G6lYgqf-CxTXqfO2Vwppc2rxQokKuxeTtAxup0qYcDGYw8_27rBf0we-3v7iRdtGtO5UciJnSekam5BI-bCLL3hLu9iAmXpVQA0gJsl_RsD9p7bC2euwmFNeatBznbuyEnIb6rp2ZLUnjhGqnXrSknDHyqvp5Vm6wYqi9fvZJKXsp-kF1DTo3yx4HQ5MYWzJVJ8h6jqn5H_3uwmc8KbkQk7fYmLjVQd-Zj1y1fyq1VGoppTSFP8LTrNTy_FSp5TsBP2SiQJgpg3uEAMFnhuhACTB3TDey4Hd4oYAXC8iF6IAcNwJMiTJnyAemN3h_UGYf91wnbY_iQ_B5GKtO3Db0ry01_5LxqdVXAAAA__-u5ZWY) charged in September's statewide voter fraud sweep. The defendants include 16 non-citizens and four felons who were on probation, with cases filed in 13 counties. Duval County has the most, with four. Uthmeier's office named 12 of them when it [announced the charges](https://email.editor.joinflyoverflorida.com/c/eJykkD1uxCAUhE-DOyzA-K-gSONu06a0XuCxS4TBgre29vaRV7lBuilG34y-r9t6gxBDun_ChsZnvyY8a0QiLOuRCYsv8HQFHQWHkNyOhLQqoQYuJZf9CpbCgauGxplRTyC-GzRynPWohZyG5mEkdiMoIaXyVs0WnJ8Bezko2wnoJtsEc_GklL0U_aB0C97PsofB4iTGDi3TAl2gXNqfHJKPr3xg8TGX4KC1eWuieRDtlXUfTC1MLed5tturPpPNUOmqMLVcI0wtYr6yZmr5I_C95Ir2SblU_oDkuMtn4krwkFywtGGiyo9MId35WwdTS1OM288QY6jDyLS4bxDi-wv9U-Nh1G8AAAD__7FliBk) Sept. 24. At the time, Uthmeier said, _"Every illegal vote that should not be there hurts the votes of lawful American citizens."_ An [ABC Action News review](https://email.editor.joinflyoverflorida.com/c/eJyk0LGOpDAMBuCngS4oyYTAFCmuoZtrr0RO4sz4FAgKXtC8_YrRvsGWtj5Z_v9_j_kBlGl9_oUFXSppXvHcMzJjnY_CWFOFr1gxMkWENW7IyLOW2gqlhOpnCEwHzgba6AYzgvQtOjXczWCkGm37csr2o7Rp0BpAem_7qIzXA_qb9zp41ZK77imleiV7q00HKd1VDzbgKIcbhsZIjMSldv8LrSm_y4E15VIpQhfK0mb3Yt725van0VOjp_M8O4ZlAw9vPV6k0dOVrNFTLgGy-BlIMMIiaD1wZ3oC47WtGHBl8ckvPgWIADvuIhCjyHAKXCEwRgHpIhfcxYkVL8dtdXE7KWfa7dAY-VyA8udP_mXFh9PfAQAA__-RbZSA) found at least eight non-citizen defendants charged under a law that didn't exist when they allegedly voted. The attorney general's office said those cases remain under investigation. Attorneys for two defendants, including a Fort Myers mother who came to the U.S. as a toddler, say their clients received voter ID cards before voting.
## Tallahassee, County Strike Tentative Deal
Tallahassee Mayor-elect Jeremy Matlow and Leon County Commission Chair Christian Caban [unveiled a 20-year fire services agreement](https://email.editor.joinflyoverflorida.com/c/eJyk0DGO6yAUheHV4A4LMLZxQfEad3ntlNYNXBJGGCy4sZXdjzJbmOaUn47-r9t2g5hifvyHHW0oYct4tYREWLezENZQ4eUreooeIfsDCWlTQk1cSi7HDRzFEzcNnbezNiDuHVo5L3rWQpqpe9o5OADAyRiljVm0GJQJYgx3WAYnjOqi_XhSylGKcVK6hxAWOcLk0Ih5QMe0QB-p1P67xBzSu5xYQyo1euhd2btkn0RHY8M_plam1uu6-svR2dPJ1PrRmVql_Ixias14cazACVKCJ7SGyF15ZXrzEkJ0EVLjkHN5ZYf8qOUoDT0PsSJvWM_osHF4VMQdMzG1dtX644opxTbNTIvHDjH9PqM_Rj2t-gkAAP__HXSNeA) Thursday, aiming to end more than a year of feuding over fire fees. Caban called it a "generational public safety deal." The county would [buy six fire stations](https://email.editor.joinflyoverflorida.com/c/eJykkLGu4yAQAL_G7jYCDHZSuLgm3bv2SmsDy8ueMFiwMZe_P-V-4eqRRqP59bV9ISfO3z9xpzWWuGXqLZEI1e0sQjVWfIVKQTgQ5nCQkGxGmRm0Bu029MInbRbHsC72iuox0qqXm12s0td5fK7aTpMJwUzLzTuk4LRTzrtILlplHjTy-vFprZ1Wbjb2gjHetMPZ01UtE_nBKgospV5-F84xvctJNaZSOeDFl31M61PkaMP0YzD3wdx775cuf9IHDuYeSs9SegbBlPCJrREN5u7xgRkwB9hRUunwyidxAqPgTVghciVoVE_2BHt5gRSo1EjAs7zBl1eWNxxYJVNtTz7Guoajc0rc5mWw6ntH_tcwyn--PVfzNwAA__8dg5Lx) for about $525,000 each and lease them back to the city for $1. Fire fees would come off utility bills, and the county could request an audit at any time. The [firefighters union backs](https://email.editor.joinflyoverflorida.com/c/eJykkL2u2zAMRp_G3hhY8u8dPHTJdrt2NBiRSljIUiAxVvL2hbt17nyA7zs4v763b5Qg8f4Td1598lvkWgKrct6OpJx9xhdlJhVijPRkZd1sZycwBsy4oVM5eBuwpXUeFuxuLa9m_hrmoTPL1D7WpTe2H3HuFja3iSeHHk3f99YMs5sMtbKee8aY0XTjZIcLev9lRpwcL93cs2uGjkk05cvvJNGHTzo4-5CyEF5c2tuwPlSfpel_NPba2Gut9VL1HU7Y2CulGjXVCIoh4ANLYW7sVTkqnvbgRD_g0ivqB7xkhsL5EMdAjOEEgYAjwZ6iPgokD55fJPEOt5eCKFDGWmCXNxNkPpukCPLPYZtXelYJQco0N0N331H-Crb6n-GP1f4JAAD__32MnfA) a provision cutting its work week from 53 hours to 42. Not everyone is sold. City Commissioner Dianne Williams-Cox told WCTV she hadn't seen the agreement and questioned its legal and financial implications. Researcher Max Epstein called the plan a good start but questioned the speed: _"What's the rush here?"_ County commissioners meet Monday, and city commissioners take it up Wednesday.
## Red Tide Bloom Hits the Panhandle
Red tide reached bloom concentrations off Bay and Gulf counties this week, and suspected fish kills have been reported in both. The [Florida Fish and Wildlife Conservation Commission found the algae](https://email.editor.joinflyoverflorida.com/c/eJykkLGO6yAQRb8Gd4kGjMEuKF7jLq_dEs3CkLDCJsKztvL3q3g_YbsjXelI93zc_A1zyev9Py7kUk1-pWMrxEzN75WppYbfsVHkHAnX-CQm9gqUuUh5kYPHwHknr7GLzuoR4bMjJ-2krQY5mu7hwMKkYkigbVQSYo9pCiQBYYqmN2OX3dsnpRwkDEbpK6Y0yQFNoBFsT0FooJi5tutXzWsqr7pTS6W2HPEa6tIV92B-bqL_J9Qs1Ly80hHei1Bzo42whceJ5w2h5o2R6fjlrrn4PHIpeTNWaLgvmMup5T8W2Z36CQAA__-qynXe) in 20 Northwest Florida samples, from Escambia County to Gulf County. Four topped 100,000 cells per liter, the threshold for a bloom. Health officials issued warnings this week near [St. Andrews State Park](https://email.editor.joinflyoverflorida.com/c/eJykkLGOpDAQRL_GZEZuYzATOLiEbC69EPXY7cFzHkB2D2j_fsX-wiaVlPRK9f7d5zumnNbnX3yTi1ucVzprJmYq87ExlVjwEwoFToFwDTsx8ayVHiSAhH5Gz-mg2WATnDUjqkdDDuzNWKNgHJrFqd7H2BGRH7QFNd46S56iVh087GB8k9zFA4AeVD9o02KMN-hx8DQq25EXRlFIvJX2taU15q_toBLzVlLA1m_vJruFea-i-yP0JPR0nmd7vpbnVQo9XXihJ4ArOqGnQkFeh-RCmHmRmKmwTLV-KMjKEtdQ6KyyMjLJHct_oaemuLCfKedUByuMer4x5Z95_qW5w-nvAAAA__9w3oKr) and West Bay in Bay County, and near [Grayton Beach State Park](https://email.editor.joinflyoverflorida.com/c/eJykkLGO4yAURb8Gd1hAMDgFxTbusu2W1gs8bLIELPzGVv5-5PmFaW5zpXN1z7_H_ICUU1n-whtdrHEueO4ZibDNRyVsscFXaBgoBYQSNiSkWQlluJRcDjN4SgfOGrrgrB5BPDt00t611UKOpltdtHoY74NGb_04GBWMCgKeOCoYrTKhS-7iSSkHKQajdA8x3uUAxuMo7A090wJDotr6V00l5k89sMVcWwrQ-_rusluJtp3d_jA1MTWd59mfr3W5SqamC8_UJOUVN6amhoFfh7ivxWMrO18afKgW_kTwK98JCPkG7T9TU9dc2M6Uc9qNZVosb0j5Z5Z-aexw6jsAAP__Awx_Xw) in Walton County. They advise people to stay out of the water there and not to harvest shellfish. Red tide can cause burning eyes, rashes, and breathing problems, especially for people with asthma or other lung conditions. Keep pets away from the water and dead fish. FWC's forecast shows surface waters moving southeast from Okaloosa County toward Citrus County over the next few days. Its next report comes Friday.

## Council of State Backs Prison Upgrades
North Carolina's Council of State [approved $18.85 million in financing](https://email.editor.flyovernorthcarolina.com/c/eJyk0L1uwyAUxfGnsTcsLvhzYOjiLV07Wjf42qHFgC4kVt6-Sqs-Qfe_ftI5H5flgs67sL_jQWYLdgl0Zk-lEC-JXY7hnnbGlfJBzM5-nS7kRUnVCwAB3ZI45kS2LFCvZhh0P601GRimdmjlpGV9Mwhdq3Wnx1ZdSXU99BsgjXJA2aPV19qZFwgAHYAcO9loPcJk23XqrnYgoKqVtLoSudn8Mz6IQ-Rys8jRu4CNjUftza2UlCv9Vqm5UvN5ns1f8BnvHNC_ukrNNt6DdV7ETeSChQSmxPFBWfwOFiuhF1hE4WcMIqFHS-IgKi7slZprNms6nfcu90PVyv1A92PX5b8PPoz6DgAA___q_Ils) Nov. 10 for energy upgrades centered on Central Prison in Raleigh. The 10 statewide elected officials [met at Tryon Palace in New Bern](https://email.editor.flyovernorthcarolina.com/c/eJykkLFugzAURb_GbC_CxkA8eOjClq4dkWM_4LXGRvZLUP6-Sn-h85Wuzjlft_nmKFJaP92Odkl-TnjWiMxY5qNQzelxrMUFrDuWQv7npFRn1aoBpATZz0fJ9UDPs2yCHcduMKFBK0ejR92arm02q_txUNelRzRLML7rlcEhoHZotFpC15B9H0opeynba99euu4qjdfB9Hc_okShWwzEuVyW-MpPLCkX3rwrOVJyF5_3JtqN-aii-xBqEmo6PZNU70mo6S0l1BSzd1Goac1P-M51g8pICe6F0lrB50fyFCEvUNkxwo7IlFbgDBtVzoU8cHnlBIeLziNQgoQn3LGkpthwnBQj1WEUul13R_EPjP-b9WnVbwAAAP__lYmQ-g), where audio and Wi-Fi problems repeatedly cut off members joining remotely. _"The Wi-Fi is just not perfect here,"_ Gov. Josh Stein said. Contractor Schneider Electric will do the work over 17 months and must cover the difference if promised energy savings fall short. State Auditor Dave Boliek pressed officials on who would verify those savings and how. That guarantee is already being tested. An earlier $38.7 million project at six prisons came up about $50,000 short in its first year, and David Mason of the state Department of Adult Correction said Schneider is "writing a check." The council approved the deal by voice vote with no opposition heard.
## Merrick Wins District 20 by 77 Votes
Democrat Tim Merrick [won the open North Carolina House District 20 seat by 77 votes](https://email.editor.flyovernorthcarolina.com/c/eJykkDEO3CAQRU-Du7EYsI1dUKRxt2lTWizMrlEwWMAa7e0jR7lBmmlG-v-9_-uxPYwPPr5_moP0K9otUiuBaqW8ndmXFD_nOxtH5aCcvf3dfCyb4GICRMBxO3MqJ9m6Yee0UnJaXEca1TKogS-Sd7smuTinaJBCmGl-GmH4QHwcnUKycpk7r-9ARBwR-TzyXsoZFzu4ZXxaRUhs4OR8Tbl_hW-6KMeU625NTsFH09t0dEHvtZ6FyR9MrEysrbW-ka33k4n1LmBiRbyPZGL9pwO3D0QLe_oUAudLzd5WEByysQTPLygFV6pUwLwqZYjUYDfxpgCbPrF-wZp4mVKYWLus3dl8CL5Mig38fRgf_vLV_1330uJPAAAA__8suJAR) after New Hanover County finished its canvass Friday. Merrick, a New Hanover County school board member, finished with 22,156 votes to 22,079 for Republican Dane Scalise, a county commissioner. Republican Rep. Ted Davis Jr. had held the seat before [asking Scalise to run in his place](https://email.editor.flyovernorthcarolina.com/c/eJykkD2u5CAQhE-DMywa_zAOCDZxNptuaLWhbbcWgwXMWHv71Ty9G7ykkpJK9X1_nssTOXDcf-NJdotuiXSXQLVSXq7MJcXXtWf0VE7Kmd3fm2NZtNKjBJAwLFdO5SJXF2i8NaYbJ9-QBTP1pldTp5rDqg3GYdPrqgHNox-nHlZlOoe4Ts7T2LD9DALAAKAeg2q77gGT6_00rM4QkOgVea4pt1v4l96UY8r1cJhT4IitS2cT7FHrVUT3S-hZ6Pm-7_YmVz-l0LNWehB6Bv0JI_Rc-ZTfSHLjQEXmV5S4I8dSpcdIsjgMXEhGJ4_0KiQLYRV6brL1180hcBmN6NV-IoevE_WnCt9W_w8AAP__v-iGnw). Merrick's [lead stood at 81 votes](https://email.editor.flyovernorthcarolina.com/c/eJyk0DFu9CAUBODT2N2zeGBsXFD8jbv925QWgbdrFAwWsEZ7-2ij3CD1SJ9m5uO23YwPPj7-m4P0PdotUiuBaqW8ndmXFJ_nIxtH5aCcvf1qPpaNMz4BIqDczpzKSbZu2Ds9z2JaXE8a52WcR7YI1u9aKiOEI5SSSUV3g4qkkI5NqJy1ivdev0FElIhMSTYIoXCxo1vkp50JqRsZOV9THu7hlS7KMeW6W5NT8NEMNh190HutZ-nEv46vHV9ba0Nr5lUv8c47vv4OKBDIOHgrUKwJvhBEk3NqBWoChXClSgV8hAgW9vQsBM6Xmr2twBlkY6nja5-1O5sPwZdp7kb2OIwPP1XqX4-8NP8OAAD__zczip0) earlier in the week. Scalise told WECT he had no comment on whether he'll seek a recount. North Carolina [allows a recount](https://email.editor.flyovernorthcarolina.com/c/eJyk0DFu9CAQBeDT4A6LAWOvC4q_cbd_m9LCMF6jYEDALsntI6-UE6SZZqTvPb2P-3rXzrvw-K9PVHswa8BWPNaKeU3ZlRie6ZG1xXJizs58NhfKyhkfKQAFuaYcS0JTV-ismiYxzrZDBdM8TAObBesOtW8DsPkmrBQjFxqM0buU277LbWZci86pCwQACcBukvVC3GA2g53lZiYEJAND62rM_e6_4wtziLkeRufoXdC9iWfn1VFrKkT8I3whfGmt9Q1NvZ6EL1cA4QvAdQThy1ugvwRFj6a6GGhGE5-hFmpRW-8CFpqfHgtth6700ClhKDTgVyV86bKyqTnvXRknMrDHqZ1_16l_HfOl-E8AAAD__5YVizg) when a non-statewide race is decided by 1% or less, and this margin is under two-tenths of a percent. Requests for county-run races are due by 5 p.m. Monday.
## Charlotte Airport Eyes $4B Buildout
Charlotte Douglas International Airport's next wave of construction [could top $4 billion](https://email.editor.flyovernorthcarolina.com/c/eJykkMFq3DAURb9G3mnQk2V7vPAiJXEKZaYlhKY7o5GeZ0SeJSO92Mzfl-kvdH3hcs75OE0nGyjE69kuOMzRTRH3QsiMeVpzKCl-rddsPZYFcw7ucw-xTFrpVgJIaKY1p7Ki4wkqP3Rd3fa-wgG63nRG9bWqbkNzqQ3UnVZtra1tPcweGjdDb6C3Vh2rMDwOAaABUMdGHer6CL0zvm8urkNAYRT6wCkfZrqnDXNMmW_O5kQh2oNLS0XDjXkton4SehR63Pf9sJfkeHvMQo8PMaFHSs6S0GOIjDlaDilakpzthiQpfCLdJaH1MuIuHbF0Kbr0lQtKc5Gc2JIMccPCC0YWevxz_vhh3n79fPv91J2_vby_vp6em-fz-_cXoccqD37dA1EobSeMui420D9e_t_a26D_BgAA__-JNJaR) and likely include a new international concourse, CEO Haley Gentry says. ## State Tax Collections Stall in October
Georgia's net tax collections [rose just 0.2% in October](https://email.editor.thegeorgiaflyover.com/c/eJykkL2unDAQRp_GdKzwYMNSuEhDt2lTImOPjSXDIDPZnzx95Kv7Brf5qqNzRvPnsTxsyumIv-2OhmNYDnxdGZmxLCETedyxRDzcB9-Mh0f_j2iBDoZWylbq5Sx0neh4kY03fedRqnuDRo6TGpWUUjeb6VxQYEfUSq3aDSv0zq6D6vqhh7DexyaZaqy0rKNvTnYhTBomq_UwjaNQHfrEVG68YUQqMdmQP_TEcnO0N9lszOcl-l8CZgFzob9x88UGtpztwbZSAuaaETBLWUcJmL9dLdt36yhndJzouFpyTCsWAXNTjD9fKed0DfWOuNuUv6L804c9DfwPAAD__xrgf60) to $2.71 billion, after three straight months of gains between 2.3% and 3.5%. The biggest drag was individual income tax revenue, which fell $115.1 million, or 8.6%, to about $1.22 billion. Withholding payments dropped by the same percentage. Other categories grew, [according to Kemp's office](https://email.editor.thegeorgiaflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOszAMgJ8mbFTYEGiGDP-Srf96I8olhkYKGAWXtvf0J073Brd4-vR9tj9u482nnNb5v1_IyjyNKz33TCJUxikzR1qozLSGN72E1kjxi3nEBvsaoAY9boX3jYKMUEXbNpGgu1ZkYTDd0AGAru620zoGA0OIfRx6gy2EvptMiKYbtLm2VbKn8aThHPoSoJkmo9F4rXszDKprKCbhcpE7zcRlTn7Kbz6oXAIvVbZ3kW1X7T-FTqE7fI68ixeO_n0SCt15WY0KXaE58arQnVGFDkCh-5XWHIQ_qdTiX3Whg9YH7fVjU-iqYuP2TDmnvT8Xmhef8k9d_vq5w-J3AAAA__87i4Jn). Corporate income tax collections jumped 48.7%, and gross sales tax collections rose 8.5%. Motor fuel tax revenue fell for a seventh straight month, down 4.3%, because Kemp has suspended the gas tax through Nov. 30. Kemp has raised the possibility of another special session. He said Nov. 4 that "budgetary issues" may need attention before lawmakers return in January.
## Zoox Robotaxis Roll into Atlanta
Amazon-owned Zoox has begun [testing driverless robotaxis](https://email.editor.thegeorgiaflyover.com/c/eJykkD1uwzAMhU8jbzZMRfLPoKGLt3TtaCgS5QiQTUNm4ySnL1T0Bl3e9PA-8vu6zlcbU9yWT7ui4SXMG55HQmbMc0hEHlfMC27uhU_GzaN_E82ylV0NUIOe90zHjo5nqLy5tB5BDRUa6EfVKwDQ1d2MWobBO30D1w2dUjDabnAolb-FVvWuiqYsljaU0I2DNoRRy9Fq3Y19L1SLPjLlhu-4IOUl2pBe9MDcOFqrZO7M-yEuH0JOQk7neTaWk93YlodCzAeXopBTIQk5AZS4CDm9iZ51phuxfcajzpSKkJq-uf6bEHKqsvH7GVOKR1euWVYb0y-a_6vtYeRPAAAA__91yIJa) in northwest Atlanta, starting around Atlantic Station. The four-passenger vehicles were [built from the ground up](https://email.editor.thegeorgiaflyover.com/c/eJykkLGOhCAQhp8GO4yg6FpQXGO3115pEAYlQcfA3Lq7T3_hcm9wzRQzXybf_3_d57sJMRzrp9lB0-rnA64cgQjS7COigx3SCod9wZPgcODeiLNsZM-F4ELNZ8J8gqVZVE63jQPR3SrQYhi7oRNCqGrTY3fr_dgOrpEDNH5QUhhlhevs6G9L01ZBl4-FFmWo2orG-1HJ0SjVj8PAugZcIEw1bbACpjUYH1_4gFRb3KuoN6Izs_aDyYnJ6bqu2i65hCl3JidD0RxkmJzKksnpjfjkSwrHmnnCBck8Q-aE_I_kV6CNn99LDJan4CDzTCHGgljcgcmpStqdV4gx5L4orrsJ8deH_tvlQ8ufAAAA__9clovB) to carry riders, with no steering wheel or driver's seat. They join Waymo and May Mobility, which already run autonomous vehicles in the city. For now, only Zoox employees and their family and friends can ride. The company plans to open a public waitlist in the coming months and launch its early rider program in Atlanta in 2027. Zoox has been testing in Atlanta since spring 2025, mapping streets and studying local driving habits and weather. Service will expand to other parts of the city over the coming year.

## Family Dollar Agrees to $63M Settlement
Chesapeake-based Family Dollar has agreed to a [proposed $63 million settlement](https://email.editor.thevirginiaflyover.com/c/eJykkbGOpDAMQL8mdEY4ZIEpKK6h22uvRJ5gmEghQbEXNH9_4vb-YEu7ePJ7_vM5f1KIIW2_aedRz3VOfElkVS7zSnuI7yXHSEW6dl-YoqdSwmwb2wEi4MdMXsPJs6NqGVdyTI-KR-wfrneIXVe9Rtf0a-eHZnBr6z0-7TA82DHjsx2eQ-uqMN48RPxAROtcjRZ907Pl5UHD03bGNbwEzaXWF5-hbCEFWuM7n1xqn_cqji_VQ0z7y9jJ2Om6rnpVX2_5NHa6lYBPTir_J2Ono7AIFI5MwvfivsHYCdHYaVUP2IMoKQsI-6_C0LWwhxhDTiCsGnnnpPAdCb4rgWguLHCU4Bm0UJKDCif_hisk8DnJ185FqjIux3XDpOuNa7adQvxnoj98wjnavwEAAP__Dfaevw) with the FTC and 17 states over allegations that it routinely charged shoppers more at checkout than advertised prices. Virginia did not join the case. Family Dollar, which is based in Chesapeake, operates more than [8,000 U.S. stores](https://email.editor.thevirginiaflyover.com/c/eJyk0LGOszAMwPGngY0KmwBhyPAt3fqtNyKTOGApQBV8VH37E9dHuNGy9Jd__nqMD5Ik2_yfVnZ6xnHj15FYlfMYaZX0DntKlI-uWQNT8pSzjFhjVwFU0I7kVU4eDZXBRTJMQ8kO-sH0BqDrysW10wSTRWtbP_WRpqmtgRCsbSIxQl-Ku3oA0AIAGnMDBF_3jBwGshN2hak5iO75pgufkmfZhGJ67yfnm9_XMrlF9XkUzb8C7wXe6XkxrtU1ZBWfuMD7B1R9RFWQw-_fmx7VwaqJV960upJ-oTxzVfeEpu64sQ0z26GNMdBFgNBSBCizC8-XpCRH1xemnleS9HuO_vGTp8OfAAAA__-D8Yjn). A judge must approve the deal. If approved, shoppers who made eligible purchases from Jan. 1, 2023, to Oct. 1, 2026, may qualify for refunds from a [$40 million fund](https://email.editor.thevirginiaflyover.com/c/eJyk0D2OgzAQBeDTmM6IMcaEwsU2dNl2SzSxh2Qk8yN7BMrtV2yOsN1II72n7_3cpzty4vX5jQt5OeZppbMkEqE8zbhwesctJczFtUskTAFz5sk0xmkADd2EQfigyWIV_YyWcKjIQz_Y3gI4V738YB3cYgfOtE0MCLGJt7ZzXYDh4fq-q9hfeQDQAYCxtgYDoenJUBzw9jBO2YYiy5ZredHB-ckr45ze20G5DttSJf8S2Ytqv5QZlRnP86zDo1yW66_MeJ3KjB-S_ph0kS1T0XvmQFoyrmXHTGt460IiiRZaRZmxyj7uJ6fExfXKNs8FOf31yj8nO7z5DQAA__9cdIHw). The total also includes a $20 million discount program offering 15% off select goods for two days, plus $3 million for the states, according to the [FTC's settlement terms](https://email.editor.thevirginiaflyover.com/c/eJykkbGOpDAMQL8mdEY4ZIEpKK6h22uvRJ5gmEghQbEXNH9_4vb-YEu7ePJ7_vM5f1KIIW2_aedRz3VOfElkVS7zSnuI7yXHSEW6dl-YoqdSwmwb2wEi4MdMXsPJs6NqGVdyTI-KR-wfrneIXVe9Rtf0a-eHZnBr6z0-7TA82DHjsx2eQ-uqMN48RPxAROtcjRZ907Pl5UHD03bGNbwEzaXWF5-hbCEFWuM7n1xqn_cqji_VQ0z7y9jJ2Om6rnpVX2_5NHa6lYBPTir_J2Ono7AIFI5MwvfivsHYCdHYaVUP2IMoKQsI-6_C0LWwhxhDTiCsGnnnpPAdCb4rgWguLHCU4Bm0UJKDCif_hisk8DnJ185FqjIux3XDpOuNa7adQvxnoj98wjnavwEAAP__Dfaevw).
## Bush Deployment Could Reach 12 Months
Navy leaders told families of sailors aboard the Norfolk-based [USS Bush](https://email.editor.thevirginiaflyover.com/c/eJykkL2upDAMhZ8mdEGxycBSpNgm3Wy7JTLEQKRAUJIB8fZXzCvcxo2Pzs_3_z28yQe_L_9oY1POedj5yoFL4TTMtPlwuxgCpdw2m2MKE6XkB1TYSgAJr4Gm4k8eNFXOzKSZ-ooNdL3uNEDbVqshZKVoBOgAgbUaoXcwN67p58mpxlXePH4A8AIA1LoGhEl1jOx6-jNiK7Ri50tMdVn59Gnxu6c53PHkVE9xq4JZSzmyaP4KtALtdV31Tudd_Mb5UQi0zzCB9o6fJJ-fQPvECrQAz0GB9pOzXDimheUqLzl-8iq_FDxnWWJwskR5JD4osZxjkjdTkiHui3R8hHhvvBeBtkrGHZcPwee2E1otG_nwbVp-Cfk0-BMAAP__bquRqA) to prepare for a worst-case 12-month deployment. The Navy has not confirmed it will last that long. The carrier left Naval Station Norfolk on March 31 for an expected six- to seven-month deployment. Families say its expected return date has been [pushed back twice](https://email.editor.thevirginiaflyover.com/c/eJykkLEOnDAQRL_GdD6xxsa4oEhDd2lTosVeYCWDT8YH4e8jovxBqpFmRiO9-fUe38iR9-UnbtSXcx53uo5IpVAeZ9w43iHFiPlomy0QRo8586hq1UoACWZEX_ikUWMV-hk1oauoB-u01QBtW629rSerlaOpcUarGakmMt1kvTHgJxMq7p89ADAAoLR-gQJfW1IUHHaTaoWuKXBJ-VVWOjkvvDPO8U4n5ZdPWxX7tZTPIZofQg1CDdd1vaB5UPZ0PQ2hBsyFfSShhsd_BAunHaNQw8aRC-Zb_ou-xyEXSnkhuV5y-h6rDPSJ6d5oL9KnbwxyIkm_C-2BglCDciC71nnbWJTWziD1FGrpZqNl0F7VruvQtFTlPnwujpGP1gpdLxty_MtQ_vP-s1d_AgAA__-oSJja). At a Nov. 9 town hall, families were told the sailors would miss the holidays. Military spouse [Sarah Streyder said](https://email.editor.thevirginiaflyover.com/c/eJyk0LHOozAQBOCnMZ0R6zj2n8LFNXT_tVeiBS-wOmMiewPH25-SV_jrkUYz35_v4Rs5cV5-40ZBjnnIdNZEIlSGGTdOV9xTwlLdbYuEacJSeDCdcRpAw33ASfigwWITw4yW8NFQAP-w3gI416whgncEOI4OCI0B52_eOxvvZGY34VfD4d0HAHcAMNa2YGDqPBmKD_wajVO2o8iyl1ZWOrgsnBnndO0HlXbatyaFVeRZ1e2XMr0y_Xme7Sl_P6Ey_fuTMv3GiQXLpUz_qlUvtJeF9KpPPb7qqiM9035tlEXTP6EcKWpckLP-QDBVPeNE-pUnKoKc5WpKiM-TU-LqvLLdsiGnzyL5IeYRzP8AAAD__-HAjD0) a year away means "missed birthdays, holidays, t-ball games, homecoming dances."
## Virginia Tax Collections Beat Forecast
Virginia collected [$394.4 million above forecast](https://email.editor.thevirginiaflyover.com/c/eJykkDHOozAQRk9jOhDjOCYULrah2uxK22yJJvaYjGQwGryg3H6V_MkJ_vrN9zR6f6_jFTnxMv3CmVzZ47jQsSUqhWSMOHN6hJwSymZPcyBMHkV41K22NUAN5xF94Z1Gg1VwEQ1hX5GDrjedAbC2urubDb0xFqwNt1PwZNvQx7Y3sQfszu2lYvf0AcAZALQxDWjwbUeaQo-Xm7bKtBS4ZGnKnXaWiRfGmB55J2l8nqvk7qWsmzr9UHpQejiOo4m84OKp-dw3U96VHmYKjEoP03O8ZPngL7qRFyoojzrH-m1QelhDfE5xKyS10E7LP6qF1ixlU3p45fjtS_3njX6-AjZriJW4sB6cEm-2U6adZuT0-rl8M_fu9P8AAAD__-7Cl2M) through October. The $2.19 billion collected in October was up 6.3% from a year earlier and $140.7 million above the monthly forecast. [The new tax on data centers' electricity use](https://email.editor.thevirginiaflyover.com/c/eJykkDHOnDAQRk9jOiPGGFgKF2no_iRdSjRrj9mRDEaDA9rbR7vJniD1N-9p9H59zV_IibflO67kyhnnja4jUSkkc8SV0zPklFCOvl0DYfIowrNpTK8BNHQz-sInzRar4CJawrEiB8NoBwvQ99XDNR2EG5AlaNvBh6Ed27vt_e1ufNd1OFbsXj4A6ADAWFuDAd8MZCiMeLubXtmGApcsdXnQybLwxhjTM58ktc9rldyjlP1Q7TdlJmWm67rqyBtunurPfb3kU5lppcCozLS84C3LZ_67HuSFCspT56j_GZSZ9hBfKB6FRAudtP0mLbRnKYcy0zvHD180NPonLlTvIVbiwn5xSnz0g7LNsiKn97PlPzufzvwJAAD__yGQk7o) brought in $66.5 million in October and $91.4 million through the first four months of the fiscal year. The state budget projects $600 million by June 30. Corporate income taxes and income taxes paid outside payroll withholding ran a combined $328 million above forecast. [Finance Secretary Mark Sickles](https://email.editor.thevirginiaflyover.com/c/eJykkL1uhDAQhJ_GdD6xxmegcJGG7tKmRIu9gCUbnxbD6d4-IlKk9Gmm-uZH8_UYHxhi2JZPTGTLOY8bvfZIpRCPM6YQ3z7HiLybJnnC6JA5jKpWRgJIuI_oSjhp1Fh5O6Mm7Cuy0Pa61QDGVKt1d91MU9tppfu-dV1Xdzhha5SbjfPGVMFeeQBwBwCl9Q0UuLolRb7HblJG6Jp8KJlvZaUz8BK2gHN855P45nKqol1Lee6i-RBqEGr4ZRKxO_h9MUINV4tQA8AlzR9M8rHtsum1TCHGkDeJK6GXeZZMJ20HyTkzOdyLLCvnY1lldiVPxEINFVv_fF3G3bRC10vCEH9mlX8-elr1HQAA__-nsorU) called it "a great place to be heading into the budget cycle," while warning those revenue sources are volatile. Withholding fell 4.6% from October a year earlier because there were fewer major deposit days, but it remained $57.5 million above forecast year to date. Sickles said the state would be cautious as it prepares its next biennial budget.

## Torch Sparks Rockefeller Building Fire

My friend, you know the truth:
---
* These charges are an attempt to criminalize investigative journalism.
* These charges are an attempt to distract from what our reporting exposed as insecure elections in Minnesota.
* These charges are now the basis for a landmark 1st Amendment case where everyone’s right to speak truth to power is on the line.

---
Here’s what REALLY happened in Hennepin County.
---
* >> We never applied for a ballot.
* >> We talked to election clerks, asking questions and getting answers so that Americans could know what was really happening in the elections.
* >> We never signed an affidavit, procured a ballot, or even touched a ballot.

---

## Commerce Secretary To Testify Before Congress
Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick [_has agreed to testify before Congress_](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLtutDAUhJ8GOiPflkvh4m_o9m9TInM4Xk5ibGR7Qbx9RPII6UYazWjm-3hOT0uewuu_3dAUF6eAZ_ZYCqbJ-XdGm2OwKdGBGW3ylwWPk-SyZUIw8ZgsFDpwEvViHKJEVaMR3aA7LeWg6tW4XkPfq051M-puHuYeBgdSckAtZ8trMnedEOIhhBJyaNTSgmgfXPd9D07LSnNcqMTUfEYKZUXnr3hgaiButTdrKXuu1L9KjpUcz_Nswgz3jduv5LhHT4UgV3KEGF4J86_cNkyALCMkLDZdbI2nTQvz7xIIvljBXMhdbL8T74QsHLSQZRlsWKxnCYJt-cAHVSez7Cd5T7ntKs1fmyX_s678jelh5HcAAAD___JNjwA) amid bipartisan concerns about the Nvidia spy scandal and the agency's enforcement of chip export controls.** ** A growing number of Republicans want Lutnick to answer questions about [_the Commerce Department's apparent delay_](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkD2O5CAUhE-DMyx44L-AYBNnvemGFsaPNjsYWvDaVt9-5LnCZCWVVKXv-_dYHjbEkJ5_7YGGfF4SXjUiEZbFx3dFW3OypYQTK9oSP9ZFXEBAz6Xksluso3DiIpvNeERA1aCRw6QHDTCpZjfTuKJCq6dJqc4KEOsgPPS6H0AJv65NMPeclLKTUkmYWrX1Tvad0OM4Oq-BaYFboFza_zkk2tHHTz6xtC4fTTQ70asy9YfBzGC-rqt1a70x7p7BfEcG854vWzYe35SC--LVZSK-Yq2YiKczbMHyA5-2vhA3TlgpHDl9GMxNMdvrCjGG2g9Mi-dhQ_w5p98pOw18BwAA__9_zIJk) in adding Singapore-based company Megaspeed International to the U.S. government's Entity List, which would have restricted the company's ability to get access to advanced AI chips. Megaspeed was previously led by Alice Huang, the suspected Chinese spy who had an affair with now-resigned Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang. The U.S. government suspects Megaspeed of directing advanced Nvidia chips to China, circumventing a U.S. export ban.
## Flu Spreading Early, Quickly in US
The flu season is underway early this year, and [_it 's quickly intensifying_](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGO8yAQhJ_G7hyxGDAUFH-TLn97pbVZloQTwRHGjnJPf_LdI1w5GmlG3_dxmS-Yciq3__hg3-IyF36tmVvjOse8rYzrUrDWtPPKWPMbKfMshTQDwAB6Rmpp5xn64COz5LFnD5NTk5LSjf3dmwBWGDLMYBULpyFOViMJCsQuuj75Yw4ANMAI0p3GYAiMFspaS1HJTgkOqS319Lmk0u4c83vZuZ5oefTZ31t7rt34r5PnTp7xeRAc1RFqS5S5k-eYt-EXZkgl5o3LFw47EqXCgwF9Vcx0RTuZQGgl6RDAxHCVzlnVVx-er5RzWs3UKXF7YMo_7-1vznYvvwMAAP__VHiAXw). The [_Centers for Disease Control and Prevention_](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkDFywyAQAF-DOmt0JySjgiKNOqdNqWHgsEhOwgMYxr_PxF_IB3Zn9-u23UzgcN4_zUG6-Lid1DJTKZQ2z89MJsfTpBQqZTKJX8YybTjgfAG4wLQZW0KlDTqnPRHS2JGG6yKvEnEZu13TQk6SkugtTFaRHKVfvJ0AlAJYVBf0Hw4AJoARcOlHN1uYp0EqpayXKORALpSY-u8YzrKT51eslHobj471Xsoji_FD4Cpwba311tn-HqvA1fOzBmoC1_xMlQKzOS0JXN8FjejnImW_l4O7pN2jBeaQ56uQw_0wgd-G8r8vVeNvAAAA__-b3nah) reported on Friday that seven states had high flu activity last week, including at least 2.6 million illnesses, 36,000 hospitalizations, and 2,100 deaths so far this season are tied to flu infections. **Whatever happened to the View-Master?** A chance encounter at Oregon Caves in 1938 marked the unlikely beginning of a remarkable story. Harold Graves, who ran a Portland postcard company called Sawyer's, spotted a photographer named William Gruber shooting with two cameras taped together. A year later, [their invention](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkMGK6jAYRp-m3UWaNE3bRRbei73IxUFUdFl-kz9txrSRJFPHtx_0FWb58cHhcC67fgfW2Xn4gAllMr6f8REdpoShN-4rIkQ_Qwh2wYgQ3BOUw54VTBBKCa16UMku2NNcS4PIsMxR0rrlNWesLfNRQnuFQmMlanUFowE1pwCGg1DaoChzK184SmlFaUlZuyq1UFRUBW-aRhnOMl6gtsmH1ae3cxrRuKdfMKyUn3Inx5TuMSvXGesy1t19HCcIt9eZsc7ZmOw8ZKw72znBgOQIjyeGSM7bzWW3Pp42B_Jv253Ifv33P_njvwknB0RH9qBukVD2XpGcfAJHBGiODRXAqooXdSGudcNqDnmQ-v6wztko6owXwwTWvf3S76oukv0EAAD__06Dios) debuted at the New York World's Fair. The magic of the View-Master was not only the 3D. It was the Kodachrome. You held the viewer up to a lamp, the film glowed from behind, and the colors came out richer than anything in a magazine. The eyepieces shut out the room. Then came that satisfying ka-chunk of the lever, and you were somewhere else. It was not a children's toy at first. The earliest reels were aimed at adults: the Grand Canyon, Yellowstone, Yosemite, Hawaii. The military bought 100,000 viewers to train troops during the war. Then Sawyer's picked up the Disney license, and everything changed. Mickey, Bambi, the Flintstones, the Apollo missions, _Star Wars,_ and more created a stereoscopic world for children. More than 1 billion reels were sold. Most families ended up with a shoebox of reels in the hall closet, and the design never budged, so every reel ever made still fits every viewer ever made. Eventually, video games ended the long View-Master run. The Beaverton plant closed in 2001, and the scenic reels stopped in 2008. But a [live-action View-Master movie](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkD2OpTAQhE8DmRFt_gMHm5C9TTdE_ezm0StjI7sHxO1HzBUmLZU-VX3_XssL2XP4_MWdjKxxCXRlTyKUltV_ZcIcA6bEJ2XC5G-0nhZd614BKOgWtMInLVA6sxJpakoyMEzt0Go9NeVmLDocxmHsgfToVmo7vTp49_Y9NYiOSjYPDgA6gAb0VDWut9B3dTuOo11bXbQ1OZaYqv-Rg2y0-juelCob99KbTeTIRfOn0HOh5-u6qmwTUXDI_n46hZ6fV4WedxQhrxyd5OPB4aNOpkvtmIWSQoeHoHAM6mLZVI7hVpQtHqQwCWd5GB1Mo-6gehLrqUzGHRd7z7kfirb-7Mj-Z5n8zudp9HcAAAD__0q-jaU) is reportedly in development at Sony. A chance encounter at Oregon Caves in 1938 marked the unlikely beginning of a remarkable story. Harold Graves, who ran a Portland postcard company called Sawyer's, spotted a photographer named William Gruber shooting with two cameras taped together. A year later, debuted at the New York World's Fair. The magic of the View-Master was not only the 3D. It was the Kodachrome. You held the viewer up to a lamp, the film glowed from behind, and the colors came out richer than anything in a magazine. The eyepieces shut out the room. Then came that satisfying ka-chunk of the lever, and you were somewhere else. It was not a children's toy at first. The earliest reels were aimed at adults: the Grand Canyon, Yellowstone, Yosemite, Hawaii. The military bought 100,000 viewers to train troops during the war. Then Sawyer's picked up the Disney license, and everything changed. Mickey, Bambi, the Flintstones, the Apollo missions, Star Wars, and more created a stereoscopic world for children. More than 1 billion reels were sold. Most families ended up with a shoebox of reels in the hall closet, and the design never budged, so every reel ever made still fits every viewer ever made. Eventually, video games ended the long View-Master run. The Beaverton plant closed in 2001, and the scenic reels stopped in 2008. But a is reportedly in development at Sony. ## Texas Maternal Death Rate Falls
A [new state report](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkbGOpDAMhp8mdKAkk4WhoLiGbq-9EjkTZ8Ynk6DEBztvfwLdPcGWn_3L8qf_1-fyCcSUnj9hxUm-Yl4SHpVRBMvyyBxiyUmgFNqxRliJ31Jgsdr2rTGt-VjgIbTjYpoweR1G0-BkhtENzmnTN6_Jajta6-FuQh8GD8YNRuM93Mego_e2oTPSG2M-jNXauM6PQx9jcPbmvI43o5zGQJJLJy8U_IIa-Z13LN0jrw1PL5GtqtsPZWdl5-M4ulBftbuS3TPvys6VBKuyc8AIf1iUnSPxNWF8UmU4HZSdL6-CWy5S_-MKgiUBt2suAkzybiGFkzyFkwruhEf7yOtKIojX-nyh_Z0pSesJUyLgf4e7LcSmTGE7iJlqPyinnysQXzryzRb2yf4NAAD__yXWoM0) shows Texas’ maternal death rate has returned to near pre-pandemic levels, though mental health conditions have become the leading cause of pregnancy-related deaths. Excluding COVID-19 deaths, the rate fell to 20.5 deaths per 100,000 births in 2024, down from 23.5 in 2021. The share of deaths involving suicide or homicide [nearly quadrupled](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLHOnDAQhJ_GdEZeY0BXuEhD96dNiRa8vrNkbLRs4Hj76O4V0kz1aWb0_fmZfzDlVJ6_cSMv71jnQteRSYR4XmsOkWsRZE4nHRG3lG9hnK2xgwbQ0M-4Sjpphib4xYQHNORhfLjROQND8_JjiCOu1PUAQ3BLj6G3yxgiPnBYgdYm-U8bAPRgjQHXLo9xiDE427nFxA6UMxSSVG7lRUJvPGK-60ncrnVrsn-J7Ifqfik7KTtd19V-IeG0_C3UVn4qO302lJ0APtEpO30ZvaEQF8x6qyyYk9x6Z3oWLOutA6G8NNNeWTQulSXVouzUsA_7lXJOxzAqZ54bpvw9I__p8PT2XwAAAP__YNCIoQ), from 5% to 19%, while obesity’s role as a factor fell by more than half. More than three-quarters were deemed preventable. The review skipped 2022 and 2023, the first full years under the state’s abortion restrictions, and was released later than its [original Sept. 1 target](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0DGuszAQBODTQGfkNQ6EwsXf0OVvX4kWvA6WDI7WKwi3f0qu8NrRpxlpfh7TA2OK-_M_buTkHfK001kSiRBPS04-cN4FmeNBJeAW0yWMk9GmUwAKbhMuEg-aoPZu1n6Amhz0g-2t1dDVq2v1cp9DD2BpviMF7Vt_MzPo1uMQWlNH92kDgBsYrcE289B3IXhrWjvr0EJlNfkomRtZSeiNJaQrH8TNkrc6uVXkVar2X2XGyozneTZflOdC_FGZn5UZv5naUIh3TGrLLJiiXIrplVmUp4SXokSLxLwX5ctaKjPW7PzrjCnF0vWV1c8NY_oOyx__Opz5DQAA___p04No). State officials said the committee jumped ahead to 2024 to keep its data current.
## SpaceX Catches Starship for First Time
SpaceX [caught its Starship spacecraft](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykUDtuhDAQPQ10Rh5jIBQu0my3aVMif8aLJWMjexZ2bx-RJgdINaP3pPf7vi93HWJIjy-9oaKXz0vCs0YkwrLYHJ0vOZEuJRxYvd5CfFPRi-BiZAAMhkVbCgcu0DpluJuhRQXTLCcpOYztqrhAADsO1iH3zgycw-QF7wVM84ewpg3qUgOAAQTnIDszT6P3TopeGu57aCRHFyiXjlYkfOnq4zsfWDqbtzaqlWivTf_ZiFsjbud5dsnYq8bFN-JWbcBk8fp2_XdfLOpnsitWBgOtrJIudQ078zE8VmLa5EKVmZwrYWEF7eX5ZptO-DwuxCY98llMsi3K7WeIMdRxaiR_bDrE33T0z1EPJX4CAAD__05ojvU) with the Starbase launch tower's mechanical arms on Saturday, a first for the rocket's upper stage and a key step toward full reuse. The ship spent about 22.5 hours aloft, becoming only the second Starship to reach orbit and [releasing 26 Starlink satellites](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkDGO5CAURE9jZ7QA03gcEGzibDbd0PqGj0GLDYI_tuf2q25pTzBZlV6pVKo_n8snxBSP7TfsaOj2eTnwagmJsC42J-drPghqjSc2D3tM31RhkVxqJgQTzwUsxRMX0TuzcjeJHo0YJzUqxYXug7H6Q0rr5PAcVjlMdvST0E8N8IHWO677aF5tQoinkJwL9VinUXvvlBzUyv0gOsXRRcr1QQEJb2g-fecT68PmvU8mEJXWDb86OXdyvq7r0QpYfNFOzm_N8C4pV6CYj07OCb4OG7CxN7QVPP1P3syGXBpF-7cxC2QDawS1hVjYVylYX3ZD5lPcAjGh-mpcuWJKsemxU3zbIab3MvrhoaeR_wIAAP__7YuOuw). But the Super Heavy booster [scrapped its tower return](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGunDAQAL8GOiPb-OAoXKShu7Qp0WKvDysGI-8Cx99Hl194_Wg0mj-v6QUxxe39G1a0_Al52vCihMxYJpeTDyVvDKXEEynAGtPNBSYtdSeUEuoxgeN44qRqb2fpB1WjVf1gemOk6urFKvdou-BmNejh2bkWZTd78EPf6qeDwdTRfm1KqYfSUirTzEPfheCNbs0sQ6sqI9FHzqXhBRk_QCHd-cTSuLzWyS7MO1Xtr0qPlR6v62qOLZ5YCDl7uL9UpUcoHF1CqvRIOzj8iATH5hYkQQyFlriL-WCxAxGSOHYx50yMRThgt4iQiyAIyDcJgr9YF-v3K6YUqesrI98rxPS_iH848rT6XwAAAP__-f6MmA) minutes after launch and self-destructed over the Gulf of America, ending SpaceX's bid to catch both halves. SpaceX said early signs point to a low-fuel alarm, and engineers are still pinning down the cause.
## Cold Front Soaks Texas, Chill Follows
A cold front [moving across Texas](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLEOpCAYhJ8GOww_Iq4FxTV2e-2VBuFnJYti4D_dffuLl3uDa6aYfJmZzK_n_LQxxf31025o6BPyvONVExJhmV1OPpS8ky0lnliD3WL6UrGzFFJzAA79bB3FE2dovFmEH6FBA8OoBqUE6GY1KORiFQwOH_2gtO67EaTQj0fQgxoX3URzpwFAD1IIUO0yDjoEr2SnFhE6YEqgj5RLSysSfmwN6ZtPLK3LW5PMSnRU1v1gcmJyuq6rdSm6t1zz70p5v6nbR0srFianu47JCeAWxeT0D-TFxp271e4OK39lHkreeD0y0ZdT5lf0WI-C1nNaY-UX4ht3z-TUFOOPK6YUqx6YEq_NxvR3Hf3nqaeRfwIAAP__OmWMXA) is bringing widespread rain and storms today ahead of a sharp cooldown. Houston could see 1 to 2 inches of rain, with locally heavier totals into tonight. The threat of severe weather is low, but strong winds can’t be ruled out. North Texas could see [about an inch](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLFugzAQhp8GNiOfMRAGD12ypWtHdMTnYNXgyL7i8PYVUd-g66fT_f_3f92mG_rgt8cnrmT45eK0UcmBmClN9xisS3FjTMnvlB2uPhyccFJS9QJAQDfhnf1OE9TWzNKOUJOBYdSD1hL6ejHuMrdybkHBKEfZoroADJIuFl3XzcrW3pzfAKADJSXoZh6H3jmrVatn6VqotCTrOaaGF2J6YXbhiDul5h7XOpiF-Zmr9qNS10pdSymNiy99epwHJyLkhVKlrhZDwCz-gDgFRSEWheibNiu2mHgR7wyRGRNnEZBJZOSfZPGok7HP4kPwuR8qLR8r-vCuwf9cbzfqNwAA__8Kh4eA) of rain, with the heaviest falling this morning. Highs in Dallas-Fort Worth will struggle to reach the low 50s, and gusty winds will make tonight’s lows in the 40s feel even colder. In San Antonio, the strongest storms are expected [east of the city](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkbHSozoMhZ8GOmVsx5BLQXEbun_bLRlhy8ETYzG2Asnb7ySzb7C1vpH0nfP7Z_7BmGK-_8KNRnkFnjOdNZEIldlx8qFwFiwlHlQDbjG9peBslOlBa9DdjE7iQbNu_bgoP-iWRn0b7M1apft2HbHzy-DtoM1i_jODs8GqrrdG91bhtXNtHD_btNadNkppe1mGWx-Ct-ZqFxWuurGKfBQuF1lJ6IU1pDcfVC6OtzaNq8hem-v_jZkaMwV-VcyYhXPkD9GY6ePUmCmxw9SY6SR6UPZQhctWwfEzedjRPeD-rPKGM2ZfYcWYAD_j5OEbA-C-F0a3UoWKGf4egcCFHFb5olQF6s5S4UGlHDElgu_TgLHsXARWwuMNns-887PUtox-P2NKsfa3xqr7hjF91eQfGzlG8ycAAP__dBKn-w), with gusty winds and small hail possible. subject: Fighting to make sure America remembers
body:
The legacies of our veterans are too important to forget

The legacies of our veterans are too important to forget

| | | |
---
Friend,
---
During World War II, when I passed another Black soldier, we didn't need to say a word. We just held up two fingers in a V.It stood for "Double Victory." Victory over fascism overseas, and victory over racism here at home.My name is Enoch "Woody" Woodhouse. I'm 99 years old, and I'm one of the last of the Tuskegee Airmen.I grew up in Roxbury, in Boston, in a family of preachers. After Pearl Harbor, my mother encouraged me to serve. So, in 1944, I graduated from English High School and enlisted at 17, along with about 20 of my classmates. My brother became one of the first Black Marines trained at Montford Point.
---
[](https://email.editor.goppresidential.com/c/eJyckb1u3DAQhJ-G6iyIP0fpChYBDpfKiZEmJbFHrqiFRVIhqfPrB3JUpnK7PzPzYX6_2leglVL4ARFNyNtmS7UzhaVRCi1HeMe6F4SIhRxYMQj9wvkLv1hwjZ5oFXTeKNBKa92h4eNVjUorobrF4DjJ8aqmhxzU9BDDPDsxT_7xmBz3zsmOzCHIOb9woQYheqfGq5iucpYjapyRqQE9tVz6I1vBSh5TI1h7l2O3mqW1rTL5jYk7E_eKbi_Yn2HTExsWSNVhalj6XAITd3g6G3aszVYKCUv9ZLIfOfsl7xWZvNe8F4fWZY9M3r7_fHv7xbW4TJwJvbdoI3raI5M3jEDrOfz3xORtgeKhvltwf86Vg7gBhcTk7f_u513Dcqh2xfjtg9aVqh6ZGsLh8snbvtrQ04i_AQAA__8_B6Ya)
---
I passed the exams for flight training. Then the Army ended the program before I could start. I went to officer school instead, and at 19, I was commissioned as a second lieutenant.**Friend, some of the hardest moments of my service had nothing to do with the enemy.** Once, traveling by train, a porter told me, "We don't ride that train," and I had to wait for the next one.At officer school in Texas, I waited 40 minutes for a table in the dining hall. When they finally seated me, it was behind a screen that walled me off from everyone else.I couldn't eat that steak. I just couldn't. For eight weeks, I lived on hot dogs, hamburgers, and milkshakes from the snack bar. But I didn't quit. I became a finance officer with the Tuskegee Airmen, which meant I was the paymaster. Back then, you didn't write checks. You paid in cash._I had the most important job on base. Everybody knew me._**And I served with the finest men I've known in my life, no matter their race.**
---
[](https://email.editor.goppresidential.com/c/eJyckb1u3DAQhJ-G6iyIP0fpChYBDpfKiZEmJbFHrqiFRVIhqfPrB3JUpnK7PzPzYX6_2leglVL4ARFNyNtmS7UzhaVRCi1HeMe6F4SIhRxYMQj9wvkLv1hwjZ5oFXTeKNBKa92h4eNVjUorobrF4DjJ8aqmhxzU9BDDPDsxT_7xmBz3zsmOzCHIOb9woQYheqfGq5iucpYjapyRqQE9tVz6I1vBSh5TI1h7l2O3mqW1rTL5jYk7E_eKbi_Yn2HTExsWSNVhalj6XAITd3g6G3aszVYKCUv9ZLIfOfsl7xWZvNe8F4fWZY9M3r7_fHv7xbW4TJwJvbdoI3raI5M3jEDrOfz3xORtgeKhvltwf86Vg7gBhcTk7f_u513Dcqh2xfjtg9aVqh6ZGsLh8snbvtrQ04i_AQAA__8_B6Ya)
---
After the service, I went to Yale and then Boston University law school, and I practiced law for more than 40 years.In 2007, the Tuskegee Airmen received the Congressional Gold Medal, and the President of the United States saluted us to make up for all the salutes we never got. People sometimes call my story Black history. To me, it isn't. _It's American history. Our history._ And I've lived long enough to believe that somehow, somewhere, we Americans get our act together and do the right thing.**But only if we remember, Friend.** That's why I'm writing to you on behalf of the American Veterans Center. This November, I joined AVC in Washington and shared my story with hundreds of cadets and midshipmen, the young men and women who will lead our military next.
---
[](https://email.editor.goppresidential.com/c/eJyckb1u3DAQhJ-G6iyIP0fpChYBDpfKiZEmJbFHrqiFRVIhqfPrB3JUpnK7PzPzYX6_2leglVL4ARFNyNtmS7UzhaVRCi1HeMe6F4SIhRxYMQj9wvkLv1hwjZ5oFXTeKNBKa92h4eNVjUorobrF4DjJ8aqmhxzU9BDDPDsxT_7xmBz3zsmOzCHIOb9woQYheqfGq5iucpYjapyRqQE9tVz6I1vBSh5TI1h7l2O3mqW1rTL5jYk7E_eKbi_Yn2HTExsWSNVhalj6XAITd3g6G3aszVYKCUv9ZLIfOfsl7xWZvNe8F4fWZY9M3r7_fHv7xbW4TJwJvbdoI3raI5M3jEDrOfz3xORtgeKhvltwf86Vg7gBhcTk7f_u513Dcqh2xfjtg9aVqh6ZGsLh8snbvtrQ04i_AQAA__8_B6Ya)
---
AVC recorded it, so it will be there long after I'm gone - and that's why I'm so passionate about AVC's work. _They make sure America never forgets the service and sacrifice of our veterans._ AVC is a nonprofit educational organization. Its mission is to preserve and promote the legacy of America's veterans and active-duty service members, from World War II through today. Its work includes:
---
* **The National Memorial Day Parade** in Washington, D.C., the nation's largest Memorial Day event
* **The Annual Veterans Conference** every Veterans Day weekend, where veterans of every generation share their stories with hundreds of cadets and midshipmen
* **AMERICAN VALOR: A Salute to Our Heroes,** a two-time Emmy-winning special broadcast nationwide
* **Oral histories and documentaries** that record veterans' stories in their own words, so they're never forgotten

---
AVC is funded entirely by people like you, and every gift is tax-deductible. _**[Friend, will you join me with a gift of $25, $50, $100, or whatever you can give today, so the stories of every American who served are remembered and passed on to the next generation?](https://email.editor.goppresidential.com/c/eJyckb1u3DAQhJ-G6iyIP0fpChYBDpfKiZEmJbFHrqiFRVIhqfPrB3JUpnK7PzPzYX6_2leglVL4ARFNyNtmS7UzhaVRCi1HeMe6F4SIhRxYMQj9wvkLv1hwjZ5oFXTeKNBKa92h4eNVjUorobrF4DjJ8aqmhxzU9BDDPDsxT_7xmBz3zsmOzCHIOb9woQYheqfGq5iucpYjapyRqQE9tVz6I1vBSh5TI1h7l2O3mqW1rTL5jYk7E_eKbi_Yn2HTExsWSNVhalj6XAITd3g6G3aszVYKCUv9ZLIfOfsl7xWZvNe8F4fWZY9M3r7_fHv7xbW4TJwJvbdoI3raI5M3jEDrOfz3xORtgeKhvltwf86Vg7gBhcTk7f_u513Dcqh2xfjtg9aVqh6ZGsLh8snbvtrQ04i_AQAA__8_B6Ya)**_
---
[ **Yes, I'll Help America Remember the**
**Legacies of Our Veterans**](https://email.editor.goppresidential.com/c/eJyckb1u3DAQhJ-G6iyIP0fpChYBDpfKiZEmJbFHrqiFRVIhqfPrB3JUpnK7PzPzYX6_2leglVL4ARFNyNtmS7UzhaVRCi1HeMe6F4SIhRxYMQj9wvkLv1hwjZ5oFXTeKNBKa92h4eNVjUorobrF4DjJ8aqmhxzU9BDDPDsxT_7xmBz3zsmOzCHIOb9woQYheqfGq5iucpYjapyRqQE9tVz6I1vBSh5TI1h7l2O3mqW1rTL5jYk7E_eKbi_Yn2HTExsWSNVhalj6XAITd3g6G3aszVYKCUv9ZLIfOfsl7xWZvNe8F4fWZY9M3r7_fHv7xbW4TJwJvbdoI3raI5M3jEDrOfz3xORtgeKhvltwf86Vg7gBhcTk7f_u513Dcqh2xfjtg9aVqh6ZGsLh8snbvtrQ04i_AQAA__8_B6Ya)
---
I still hold up two fingers in a V now and then. These days, the victory I'm after is making sure America never forgets the men and women who served. _**[I hope you'll join me and AVC in securing that victory with your most generous gift today.](https://email.editor.goppresidential.com/c/eJyckb1u3DAQhJ-G6iyIP0fpChYBDpfKiZEmJbFHrqiFRVIhqfPrB3JUpnK7PzPzYX6_2leglVL4ARFNyNtmS7UzhaVRCi1HeMe6F4SIhRxYMQj9wvkLv1hwjZ5oFXTeKNBKa92h4eNVjUorobrF4DjJ8aqmhxzU9BDDPDsxT_7xmBz3zsmOzCHIOb9woQYheqfGq5iucpYjapyRqQE9tVz6I1vBSh5TI1h7l2O3mqW1rTL5jYk7E_eKbi_Yn2HTExsWSNVhalj6XAITd3g6G3aszVYKCUv9ZLIfOfsl7xWZvNe8F4fWZY9M3r7_fHv7xbW4TJwJvbdoI3raI5M3jEDrOfz3xORtgeKhvltwf86Vg7gBhcTk7f_u513Dcqh2xfjtg9aVqh6ZGsLh8snbvtrQ04i_AQAA__8_B6Ya)**_
---
With gratitude, Enoch "Woody" Woodhouse II Lt. Colonel & original Tuskegee Airman On behalf of American Veterans Center
---
| | | [ **Honor Our Veterans with American Veterans Center**](https://email.editor.goppresidential.com/c/eJyckb1u3DAQhJ-G6iyIP0fpChYBDpfKiZEmJbFHrqiFRVIhqfPrB3JUpnK7PzPzYX6_2leglVL4ARFNyNtmS7UzhaVRCi1HeMe6F4SIhRxYMQj9wvkLv1hwjZ5oFXTeKNBKa92h4eNVjUorobrF4DjJ8aqmhxzU9BDDPDsxT_7xmBz3zsmOzCHIOb9woQYheqfGq5iucpYjapyRqQE9tVz6I1vBSh5TI1h7l2O3mqW1rTL5jYk7E_eKbi_Yn2HTExsWSNVhalj6XAITd3g6G3aszVYKCUv9ZLIfOfsl7xWZvNe8F4fWZY9M3r7_fHv7xbW4TJwJvbdoI3raI5M3jEDrOfz3xORtgeKhvltwf86Vg7gBhcTk7f_u513Dcqh2xfjtg9aVqh6ZGsLh8snbvtrQ04i_AQAA__8_B6Ya)

name: The PreBorn! Team
subject: One ultrasound. One precious life. One beautiful calendar.
body:
Imagine a young woman who has just discovered she's pregnant.

| | | | [](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyckU2rnTAQhn9N3Cn5VhcuLhWh0FvaXmiXEpPRMzQmIYmnf78cOAe67nKeYR6Y9_31vr4b9BiOr-aECUtZXXRrDHD5mk2JV3AxQMpgMV7Fr5xy3TLWMrUaW_EOqzSNmxRnwz40MLF-lL3se6mb28Qck4yr3Wx02LSmu2JyU8pSJXQ_cNng9PAxxhQTlHPV6QE0OOFGY6XaN0okvZIzFToMBR0UG2NK0WNFW7qYj8ZPt1pTIeKN8IXw5cA7hqNLGbaYQ2fjSfjynAhf7A3s73hVwhdjW2s8BGdyexKxFCLmT29fGOX62w_CtTVnMngEImYlxnFkhOurnus__HX_3Jzg8DqJmOE06J-wxCtbIGJOOZYEtmI4XqYYKoRKxPyTr9_79vPHR_sKpMmTS3_Qeyy6J5IeD-Xjnab-b033if8NAAD__z6eopU)
---
Dear Advocate for Life, Imagine a young woman who has just discovered she's pregnant. She's frightened, overwhelmed, and unsure of what to do next. Maybe she hasn't told anyone. Maybe someone in her life is pressuring her to have an abortion. But what if, before making that decision, she had the opportunity to see her baby for the very first time? **That's the life-changing opportunity your gift to PreBorn! can help provide.** Through our PreBorn! Network Clinics across America, mothers facing unexpected pregnancies receive free ultrasounds, compassionate care, and the opportunity to hear the gospel of Jesus Christ. When a mother sees her baby on the ultrasound screen and hears that tiny heartbeat, she has the opportunity to recognize the precious new life growing within her. **Your gift of just $28 helps provide one life-saving ultrasound and shares the hope of the gospel with a mother considering abortion.** And as our thank-you for your gift of any amount, we'll send you PreBorn!'s beautiful new **2027**** _Celebrate the Beauty of New Life_****Calendar!**
---
[](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyckU2rnTAQhn9N3Cn5VhcuLhWh0FvaXmiXEpPRMzQmIYmnf78cOAe67nKeYR6Y9_31vr4b9BiOr-aECUtZXXRrDHD5mk2JV3AxQMpgMV7Fr5xy3TLWMrUaW_EOqzSNmxRnwz40MLF-lL3se6mb28Qck4yr3Wx02LSmu2JyU8pSJXQ_cNng9PAxxhQTlHPV6QE0OOFGY6XaN0okvZIzFToMBR0UG2NK0WNFW7qYj8ZPt1pTIeKN8IXw5cA7hqNLGbaYQ2fjSfjynAhf7A3s73hVwhdjW2s8BGdyexKxFCLmT29fGOX62w_CtTVnMngEImYlxnFkhOurnus__HX_3Jzg8DqJmOE06J-wxCtbIGJOOZYEtmI4XqYYKoRKxPyTr9_79vPHR_sKpMmTS3_Qeyy6J5IeD-Xjnab-b033if8NAAD__z6eopU)
---
Filled with stunning photography, encouraging Scriptures, and space to record your prayers and blessings, this special calendar celebrates God's goodness and the extraordinary gift of every human life. clean_body: Imagine a young woman who has just discovered she's pregnant. | | | | Dear Advocate for Life, Imagine a young woman who has just discovered she's pregnant. She's frightened, overwhelmed, and unsure of what to do next. Maybe she hasn't told anyone. Maybe someone in her life is pressuring her to have an abortion. But what if, before making that decision, she had the opportunity to see her baby for the very first time? That's the life-changing opportunity your gift to PreBorn! can help provide. Through our PreBorn! Network Clinics across America, mothers facing unexpected pregnancies receive free ultrasounds, compassionate care, and the opportunity to hear the gospel of Jesus Christ. When a mother sees her baby on the ultrasound screen and hears that tiny heartbeat, she has the opportunity to recognize the precious new life growing within her. Your gift of just $28 helps provide one life-saving ultrasound and shares the hope of the gospel with a mother considering abortion. And as our thank-you for your gift of any amount, we'll send you PreBorn!'s beautiful new 2027 Celebrate the Beauty of New LifeCalendar! Filled with stunning photography, encouraging Scriptures, and space to record your prayers and blessings, this special calendar celebrates God's goodness and the extraordinary gift of every human life. It also includes a 2027 Ministry Prayer Guide to help you pray for mothers, babies, and the ongoing work of PreBorn! throughout the year. Every new life is worth celebrating. Will you help protect the next one? Gratefully, The PreBorn! Team Pop Acta Media | Inside Scoop Politics PO Box 2221 Fort Collins, CO 80522 |

## Weiser Names Transition Committee
Gov.-elect Phil Weiser named [more than 200 people](https://email.editor.thecoloradoflyover.com/c/eJykkDvO2zAQhE8jdTS41IO_CxZp1DltSmFFLW0CfIG7tpHbB06QE_ztzGAw8_267TeMKZb7T8zkxIe90JsTiVDf3xSZuhDmZztRiL-01g0b7UabVQEoWPbWKzfyssN4uhCMx3UkB_Y629l-TTA-3LracHjrQZNGuC4nwgRLCFpbMItfx-g-hQCwwKSnBS6T0QfiMvvV24Aeh1nTGaX2izzI11Q7njWk3_VF_eJrHpN7iDQeph-D2QazCfP_2McfzPbvjMLWaizCKsTOojwesZCoTPmgzqpgJlbHk2MhZpUIz48sVUnHwlFiLcrXnKMI0WC2sbuzvWNKkVc7zPqeMaa_k-S7OF_O_AkAAP__Lq6OEg) to a transition committee that will recruit and recommend leaders for the state's cabinet departments. Members include 2022 Republican U.S. Senate nominee Joe O'Dea and Colorado Chamber of Commerce CEO Loren Furman. Weiser has 20 of 21 department-level posts left to fill. His first department head is Sen. Cleave Simpson, an Alamosa Republican, as [agriculture commissioner](https://email.editor.thecoloradoflyover.com/c/eJykkD2u2zAQhE8jdTT4I5nPhYo07l7alMJqtZQXpkiCXFnI7QMlR0g3wGAG882v7_kbOHLafsJOk2CYE50tkgjV-SRuVIVgP8oKQu1La12g0Gy1vStjlBnnUnMrhDKbfp1CsAj3nibjH4Mf_Jcz_WvSYMIS0Ax-eHhnH54GF8bVGwtLAOd6nq5CY8xonHajuTmrF4BxwDv6AAjdoGllyfUmL8Icc4U1h_g7f6jeMO99nF4ipXXuR2efnX2e53lbKX2o-svv7PPi6uyz5MjCeMntSqdcFUVCUf9o1Q5vaipwbaIQFk4kqjC-m-KE8Vg5bapSOZbICEmFXBVslfGIclRSmPedW-OcqPZ1WsvJMXK7-27Q2w4c_86V_736M9k_AQAA__9l0JjB). He also named former Senate Majority Leader Dominick Moreno, a Democrat, as [budget director](https://email.editor.thecoloradoflyover.com/c/eJykkL1u7CAQhZ_G7rAAG_8UFLdxt7dNac0OwxoFAwJ2rbx95ESR0qc9o_NpvvN2227gvAuP_3CQrmi3QGfxVCvl7SRXKFeC45kMVCoz5zxBok1yOTIhmFBbyrEkwrqJ1mhrJcLYkhbTMkzDNPei3TU3g1m4HXFSSixKjdb284xqFDAvPcfW6QsohFCi570SXS_5HUANOOJkAaEZOBlXY-7qThh9zGCi9R_xRbnDeLRe77Wm0vT_Grk2cj3Ps8N7uWSueyPXn1Yj1yv9lbDHhQkxM_KElaXdefbtziCE-AxIhSHcXaDKksP3q91mbdLpvHdlnJqBPw5w_uuX-tcdX1p-BgAA__9I2YoB) and former Fort Collins Mayor Jeni Arndt as director of rural advancement. Weiser said he wants Coloradans "from all walks of life" to have a seat at the table. Sen. Lisa Frizell, R-Castle Rock, called the Simpson pick an "olive branch to rural Colorado."
## Colorado Wolf Dies in Utah
A female gray wolf from Colorado's reintroduction program [died in Utah](https://email.editor.thecoloradoflyover.com/c/eJykkLFu7CAURL8Gd15xwZjdguI17va1Ka1ruKyRsEGA18rfR44UKX2aaeZojjQfz_mJIYb99R83Ms36eaezRmqNynxSqFQa4XZkh43qnXOeMdMsuBh7gB7UnEuqmWyboXPGe2Fx7MiAfgx60HcJ3Wrswy367q0AbbUcwSuQC6hFI-KwDKoL5hoEAAWSSwU3KfiCqAY7Wu3RIhs4udBSubWVbIqpoEs-fqY3lZtNWxfN2lquTP5jYmJi-mHqsV89E9NlYGICuEL-QvozRd_7dOyud4SuD3t_NFyZmLpiXD5DjKGOmg38tWGI377216_eRnwFAAD__4kJfQA), the 20th of the state's wolves to die since releases began in December 2023. Wolf 2516 arrived from British Columbia in January 2025 and [traveled 9,000 miles](https://email.editor.thecoloradoflyover.com/c/eJykkLFu5SAQAL_G7nhiMWC_guIad7n2SmsDSx4SGASboPz9KfcL149Go_nzdr1hyun--I2FHPt43TRHJmbq16Q0qDNh-WwBmcYhpWzY6FJSWQEgwFyt19HI8wVrcDEqj3YlB_tT73o_Nlhf7v1QIeho7E7PEJV-glW4gTnQkIRwrMn9CAHAwCY3A49NyXdEo731e0SPi5YUEtf-4Bf5mmvHUGP-rl_UH76WNbsXcxvL9mtR56LOOeeD0t06jTFTpx9oUSd2Tj7Tos6nsVZvoOyizkIhoRiMTIVuFr7eMfVCQZTaGXPib1GjmDVHoQxYkW7xyfhauwttppzTsPui5UfBlP_l8P-u_HLqbwAAAP__I82JTA) across Colorado and neighboring states. Her collar sent a death alert Nov. 7. The U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service is investigating with Colorado and Utah wildlife officials. The cause of death hasn't been released. The death lowers the state's known wolf count to 44. In September, Colorado Parks and Wildlife [paused its policy](https://email.editor.thecoloradoflyover.com/c/eJykkL1u7CAQhZ_G7rD4MeBbUNzG3aZNac3CsIuCDQJ20b595ESR0qf9RvPpnPN-2S4QYjhub7CjadZvB_YasTUsW8dQsTSE_ZEdNKwLpTRDxo1TrghjhMktl1Qz2rax0RnvuQU1omH636xnvQg23o3WggrmxRU9FVLJeWEgpZ29o0p5v4zBnELGmGSCCskmwekVQM5WWe3BwjBTdKGlMrU72hRTAZd8fKUnlsmmfYzm3lqug_g_8HXga-99std6ljnvA19_vga-nvQXIRnKRyU9RBeDR1IfNePhKukpeuIwF3TQQjpITjHYF8kpP-I3semwWI5TNxbjcg8xhqr0MNPbDiF-hWt_HfZp-GcAAAD__07rkT4) of killing wolves that repeatedly prey on livestock, citing concerns the population may not grow this year. State House Republicans [denounced the pause](https://email.editor.thecoloradoflyover.com/c/eJykkL3unDAQxJ_GdEb-Ai6FizR0lzYlWuz1nSWDLXsB3dtH5ENK_y_3t7ujmfn5XJ4QU9xfP2BDSy4sO14tIRHW5cLYsBLCdhQPhO0hhChQcFFCjVxKLoel1NwKOlpk520IysHYoZXTNzOZ6aFl97b6oYdBjGEyCl3QYQWttBBCTCYYY8Yu2ltQSjlILfQge63ECjAYN7opgANmBPpIufb0RpdTruBzSJ98Yu1d3rpk30SlMf2dqZmp-bqu3q3tDnPvmZr_fTE13_Q_wiuWY03Rwc5zKblFinnnLu8N6wl_h2079kgf3o5SciV-5RS4x1LR_znxsaKjeCJTc1etL1dMKbZxYka8Nojpt1H6asmnVb8CAAD__zj3lgY), while conservation groups supported it.
## Evergreen Strings Kindness through Town
Evergreen residents wrote messages of gratitude and kindness on [more than 8,000 paper links](https://email.editor.thecoloradoflyover.com/c/eJykkL2u3SAQhJ8Gd1jsgs1xQZHG3U2b0toDi42CfwTkWHn7yHmFW00xmtHM9-tr-aKU07H-pJ1d83E5-K6ZW-Oy3Jwql8a0_7kCNa4vpdRFFy-ocJQAEoblKme92LcFuuBiRE9jxw7sZKyxLw3d5qJG9TaoKMA0BVAx-JdF4_0EYYwwdMk9hQAwgFZ6gP4JEA3Gj95G8iSM4pDaWfq2sT_zWSicMf89P1x6f-5ddltrVxX6h8BZ4Hzfdz89Vx5X4EylJZ9Z4JxTfGRjKu2msqdjFTjzh8tamA_5Ox3h4Fql3ygdAmerpfUjR560HPBtpEGr5TsMVgaI1qLWRo2hKy5cd8o51dEKo9adUv6_rX2X68fhvwAAAP__CfWKwA) for a kindness chain meant to stretch through downtown Saturday. Jules Elders, owner of the Evergreen Art School, dreamed up the project 10 weeks ago after a difficult stretch marked by a school shooting and flooding. About 60 schools, businesses, and community groups chipped in. Organizers set out to collect 5,000 links but needed about 12,000 to stretch from Elders' school at the Evergreen Design Center through Main Street. The chain was scheduled to stretch through downtown at 4 p.m. Saturday during the free Mountain of Thanks festival, with [shops offering discounts and tastings](https://email.editor.thecoloradoflyover.com/c/eJykkLHOpCAUhZ9GOwwXRbSg2MZutt3SXOEykqAYuDNm3n4zu4_wd6c4OTnf9-exPjCmeD5_40GWXVhPumsiZirrTbFSYcLjdXlkqpOU8sKLViXVKAAE6PUquV7keIXW2xCUw7ElC2YezGCmHtrdUq9RAwH5ycPsVK_kaHptcPABtAtttN9BANDQy15D1yu5IerBjc4EdNgMknzkXDreyeWUC_oc0ie_qXQuH22yO_NVm_5Xo5ZGLfd9dw7PTz5dfpX4v9Wo5UvXqIXeVJ6F6BScxZ4rCxQhZ95jSlVU_iQSjhJtBTnmU-Qgnt_IL0-NWrBwdIlW8BuQISUmOYEYtDFik6iFCbMKOvgZtrnb-Uhtsf66Y0qxjqYZ5PPAmP4d559Kf1v1NwAA__-jSZfh). One link read, _"If you're doing your best, you're doing enough."_ _"Art brings people together like no other thing ever can,"_ Elders said.

## Arizona Airports Recovering from Ground Stop
The FAA grounded every departing flight in the country for more than four hours Friday, leaving [almost 700 flights delayed or canceled at Phoenix Sky Harbor](https://email.editor.thearizonaflyover.com/c/eJyk0LGO4yAYBOCnwZ0t-A0mFBTX0OXaK61f-HeMjoAFxN7k6VfeV9hmqtF80vy7z3cMMaTHX3ySbfhZ50RnjdQalXmNOS9Hjq_UiErdwn8qhap_zcBh6oXohZrRt3DQLLFb7Dh5o2VHVmgjtdRGyW6z2nitvBIGUJJBJJy4BFgIOHilVRfstSeEUGLkSo0D3IRR-ibUKtcbjMQkpyW0XIa2EZbwyQnX-M4HlcHnZxft1tpe2fiHgWPgzvMc8OMptYLxajBwteXyZuBawYMiA4ehxJCoMnAXz8AJccXIwK2I_aPkV1r62vLe71umFL56DGXPpTFwBvSk9GQ41wxcV-yynyHGUCfNJH88MfzAXfvtq4eF7wAAAP__YpKKQg). It was the first nationwide ground stop since January 2023, and Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy [blamed aging air traffic control routers that were overloaded with data](https://email.editor.thearizonaflyover.com/c/eJykkLGupCAUhp9GOyaAoFJQbGN3t93SEDiMJ4tg4Khz5-k3s69w-z9_vu_787V-OUyYn7_dDpbcO64Z7paACOoaUynhKunMBFDbhn-hVmj-XCWXIxOCCb06T3jBqlwf7DB6M6kerJiMmtRktOo3GycXRq4Fn_k8Gj4apcCMoOboQQZlerSfPyGEFgPXenjIWRg9zUJHFWc5QKc4BKRSH7SBq_gu2cX0XS6oD1_2PtmN6Gjd8KuTSyeX-74fsbwEP7YCGV-fUSeXj1onl-gcw9ZOaCw7wpJvDMCetZw5sEblYOEERoXBi6orNWB29Zt5rP7cG7nsofXVhuPGlLCNU6f4c3eY_rPQTzNeVv4LAAD___gJiv0). Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin said officials have found no sign of a cyberattack but aren’t ruling one out. The stop reached smaller airports too, [forcing a passenger jet back to the terminal in Bullhead City](https://email.editor.thearizonaflyover.com/c/eJykkTGunTAQRVcDnZFtbAwFRZrX_bQp0WCPYRQ__GQPoPzVR2QLqeYUo6t7dH99LV9AiY7tJ7xxZviOy4F3TciMZYkp53DldB6MWOpOv7EUrP5ctNSDUEoou4BnunAx0Ia5H_zkTIuzcpNxxk3WtPts1nVw62iVWxGVD15NWmolo1VmmibV0vzkKaWs6qW1fadHNVk3KhtNHHWPjZEYiHPpeEco9J0PiOlPvrB0Pr_bNO_Mn9r0Pxr9avTrvu9uhwvq-dg8L41-PfgcYMrHTQFFBBB1Pznk-xCBajk_XEXBjfIBSQCVTy5cBdSHEx1YReVybltCwVkU9E-FRr-gMPmES1C2H1YfRD-MWhiQUowQpdByiG4wJmi03c7v1JY5fG5KiergGiO3N1D658L_O8M1678BAAD__5PInvI). Stranded travelers nationwide flooded Amtrak’s website and app looking for another way home. Flights were [up and running again at Tucson International](https://email.editor.thearizonaflyover.com/c/eJykkMGupCAQRb8GdxgpQWThYjbu3mxnaaqxaMlD6UCpmf76Sc8vvPVNbs45f76WL4wpHs_fuNPE-A7LQXdNxExlCSnn9crpPJio1C1-UylU_blAB4NUSiqzoOd40aKxWad-8M7qhiZlnbbaOqObbeqdA6SR7KjsYxg8BmPcA9zogB6dXZs4ff6UUkb1nTF9C6Nyxo7KBB1G6EnojtbIubS8EZb4zgeG9DdfVFqf9yZNG_Oriv6XgFnAfN93-31l_IwC5o-SgDllj0nAzKev-ZAhxefGVRaq504SA1ORz5LPY5WV80vAjIWjT7Q4b4IJaOVgtJcaVpDYAUiFI46OiAb3aDfeU1Om9XXHlGIdrNDdc8eY_iPyT-teE_wLAAD__xFdjxM) and Sky Harbor by Friday night. Duffy said rebuilding full capacity will take time but expects airports to be “back up and operational” by Thanksgiving.
## Rent-to-Own Deal Forgives Arizona Leases
Arizona rent-to-own customers will see [more than $4 million in leases forgiven](https://email.editor.thearizonaflyover.com/c/eJykkL2uozAUhJ_GdI7wX4DCxTZ0d9st0Yk5Dtb1T2QfQMnTr1jtG9xmqtE3o-_P1_IFIYb8_A0JLcHHLxnPFpEI6-JjKetR4p4JsbYtfGOt2Ny-yF7euRBcmAUchQMXDd1q1d1Ng-7QimHSgx4mo7vNmke_ag9KrF5Po-wHdP6BIOChRgfYd8FePCGEEao3Rt3kKCYzjMJ47UepkOke10Cl3mhDqOFTMvj4LgfWmyupi3YjejWmfjE5Mzmf53mDj4cU4vsqMDlfC0zOQlyhmJz_Y3jFTJwKL2fmbm9UEtbGXdnjyp9IPJWMb_4A983FqEziGSiUDJE3JIqYMBOTc1ft-jpDjKHdB6b7Z4IQ_52jn3o9rPwbAAD__4irjn4) under a settlement with Acima, a finance company accused of deceptive practices. Acima, which partners with retailers to rent out furniture and electronics, agreed to a [$183.5 million deal with 43 states](https://email.editor.thearizonaflyover.com/c/eJykkb2OnTAQhZ8GurnCxuanoEhDt2lTook9gLVmfGUPoLtPH90oeYLtTvHp0zk6vz6WDwwx8PYTD5oEv9aF6S6RRCgva0zJXymeLES57OGTcqbizkU3ugOlQNkFnYSLFoO1n9rOjb2paVL9aHrTj9bU-2TbtcfOWNcMVo9d83skbYeuVX71rSdVh-ntU0pZ1TbWtg89qNH2g7KrWQfdUmUa8kFSfshOmMNXYlzjK12UHy4ddZx2kWep2h-Vnis93_f9QJGUmV4bMWWMjy1dlZ4FPwNv8C6duNLzfwr-YVBO9vgCZE4nOyqghhYsHCHGkBiOM0oogkJQSCTSQSxwB9khv5MkSDfDGhjZEbh0PJFfgC4cCD5sQTBWeq7z5J_321m6vjLNdmCIf6fId1-4Jv0nAAD__4BNojI). The states alleged it pitched 90-day payoff plans but automatically put customers in 12-month leases that could cost about twice the store’s price. The company [admitted no wrongdoing](https://email.editor.thearizonaflyover.com/c/eJykkL-O3CAQh58Gd6zMgGEpXGzjVJvmipTWHB6fUTCcYNbW3dNHjvIG6T_9_ny_nvMTY4r54yfuNDJ-r3OmsyVipjqvqZTlKOmVmai2Lf6mWqmF1ww9WKmUVMOMgeNBs8FuGbUN3pmORuW8ccb5wXTbuGjbv3vt7YCoUVurIPTkHHgbFoWhi-OVp5QalO6HQd_grvzg7mpYzXoHTcL0tEQu9cYbYY3fJeOavspB9RbK3qVxY_5sQj8ETAKm8zxv768WM7V2xkoXJGC6rgmYtrKTgOlfZ--9s6AFTJQFTI8Qd5SPnMsrB2ryjZgT7ZRZllWihB6UfOLlR56RN_lgLjXTV5M_KFPFdHFGyzdGptbVcfk8Y0qxWSdM_7FjTH838__qPkb4EwAA__-Cq5Qo) and said settling an investigation that began in 2021 would let it focus on serving customers and retailers. Upbound Group, Acima’s parent company, had already set the money aside last year. The deal bars Acima from [hiding lease terms during electronic signing](https://email.editor.thearizonaflyover.com/c/eJykkL2unDAQRp_GdF7hvzUUFGnobtqUaALjxcpgE3tYxD59RF7h1p90vqPz62v6gkgxvX7ChgPDJ0wJz0rIjGUKlPPyznQkRix1jX-wFKzzMelWP6VSUrkJZo5vnCw0y2Cec-9tg4PyvfXW984266CUCx50WOanCg5dZ36b1vvQG2vsgqaJw81TSjllWufMQ3eqd75TLtjQaYPCtrhEzuXBK0KJn5wg0JXfWB5z3hoaVua9CvND6FHo8TzPx35ties9Cz0SvoCEHu8focfKwCiBOZeEV5UvTFiAZIVLqs7ILRLFnOSSiaDIisyEGyaWBf8esWCVMMcN5G2wwkGyYGIguR9lXqGi3MvdZcYq9NiUYdnPG1mfXtj2tUGk_9783eTvQf8LAAD__6NGmgU) or blocking customers from returning merchandise to end a lease. Eligible customers don’t need to do anything, as Acima or a settlement administrator will contact them.
## Camp Verde Calls for Flood Volunteers

Hello Friend, Spiritual strength doesn't come in a single moment. It's built over time. And after more than 40 years of pastoring and preaching God's Word, I've learned that consistent time in Scripture is the key to a grounded, courageous life of faith. That's why I created the brand-new _**[2027 Pathway to Victory Daily Devotional](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyckc1u3SAQhZ8G72wZBpubBYu27pW6SKVumiUiMOYimR8BpsrbV26TF8hupDlnPn2al2f1rP3ho_upA0rTvSpVWV9N6ljaAzGadBbtMGBsb4rNbB0pHemitGm-o-J6sNLYFdiAkoonLvhtATE8pAUQ7ImvFPZXrTVyuliA2y5mQRk1dvDyOkcpXSjQBdYJcd9hR7FafntdZiB8PrPVDetkUqxYur6YPsZ0TSlOJoXhkI_WciXwhbA7YfeK5iw45danVBxhdzYzMebWrR2dowTuNZ3FoDLJIoHt5ftXwtazBWV0yNq7SGCz2h9vymJPF0cf74n_TQJbLqlmNM1H974KaP0ZCGwYtP_ImxQbxkZg-yXGb79_jB_GQ5E2__HH4esqCJ_dVfqn0z75hS7Z3wAAAP__6HOZyw),**_ a weekday guide to help you start each day with biblical truth and encouragement. Every devotional in this 260-entry collection was written to help you think biblically, live obediently, and trust God more fully. Whether you're struggling with uncertainty, carrying the weight of past mistakes, or simply seeking God's direction, this resource is designed to meet you right where you are. You'll begin the year by discovering how to embrace the new beginning God offers. You'll turn your attention to Jesus Christ through Holy Week and a study of the end times. You'll follow the early church and see how the Holy Spirit empowered believers to stand firm in their faith. And you'll close the year examining the attitudes that shape your life, learning to find contentment and experiencing the freedom of forgiveness. These are not abstract ideas. They are time-tested truths drawn from over four decades of biblical teaching to help you walk closely with Christ each day. This beautifully produced 532-page devotional features a velvet red leather cover, rich gold and brown foil accents, and larger, easy-to-read print, making it both a meaningful spiritual investment and a joy to use.

**I am writing today to DEMAND that you abolish the Electoral College!**

Time and time again, Republicans have won the presidency despite LOSING the popular vote.

**So I’m demanding you do what’s right for our democracy and ensure our presidents are chosen by the PEOPLE.**

[I’m signing this letter today to DEMAND you abolish the Electoral College as soon as possible. We stand by our reporting – will you stand by us?

We stand by our reporting – will you stand by us?
| | | | Fellow Patriot,[](https://email.editor.goppresidential.com/c/eJyckUtu2zAQQE9D7STwT2nBhVtZQYs6MbJwlwTFj0JUJAWKdq5fqE0ukO3DzOA9zO-LuuiwhrQ86-jkkrdNlV3Nzufiwrte_4RUs8n3UnNK-aEwxLxFqEVMaVPDwymqGyup5pRz3jiJxEAFgwTR5k0ypPVgPTW9FXgwhMx-HuYBWiao8WhugjwOIoQYIpQh1FmDMcfCe04hEoIBCp0NNZfucCtuD9alGvTamRybVb7Vuu2AnACeAJ5sTrq6LsfFd7ksAE-b7odecAMpJz0k3Hpm-h6Q6V6j2vO9GAfI-Hq-AcwPFJ0N9wjIeL6cfvz6gEbHTYclATJ-6BL1bXxS339O6vV8U_9m1fPLDfH2emqfXq7Xz82cqksVkPGA7WdsU6Td3sO6hp0LQOESdfhfVL_6g4fEfwMAAP__LO-SNw) The minute I received a summons to appear in court on November 16th, I knew I had to write to you.**You see, my fellow journalist Cam Higby and I are facing TWO FELONY CHARGES in retaliation for exposing Minnesota’s weak, vulnerable election system.** If this Soros-funded prosecutor gets her way, we’re both headed to jail.And I need to know today... **[Will you stand by us as we fight these trumped-up charges?](https://email.editor.goppresidential.com/c/eJyckUtu2zAQQE9D7STwT2nBhVtZQYs6MbJwlwTFj0JUJAWKdq5fqE0ukO3DzOA9zO-LuuiwhrQ86-jkkrdNlV3Nzufiwrte_4RUs8n3UnNK-aEwxLxFqEVMaVPDwymqGyup5pRz3jiJxEAFgwTR5k0ypPVgPTW9FXgwhMx-HuYBWiao8WhugjwOIoQYIpQh1FmDMcfCe04hEoIBCp0NNZfucCtuD9alGvTamRybVb7Vuu2AnACeAJ5sTrq6LsfFd7ksAE-b7odecAMpJz0k3Hpm-h6Q6V6j2vO9GAfI-Hq-AcwPFJ0N9wjIeL6cfvz6gEbHTYclATJ-6BL1bXxS339O6vV8U_9m1fPLDfH2emqfXq7Xz82cqksVkPGA7WdsU6Td3sO6hp0LQOESdfhfVL_6g4fEfwMAAP__LO-SNw) **

[ **STAND WITH JAMES** ](https://email.editor.goppresidential.com/c/eJyckUtu2zAQQE9D7STwT2nBhVtZQYs6MbJwlwTFj0JUJAWKdq5fqE0ukO3DzOA9zO-LuuiwhrQ86-jkkrdNlV3Nzufiwrte_4RUs8n3UnNK-aEwxLxFqEVMaVPDwymqGyup5pRz3jiJxEAFgwTR5k0ypPVgPTW9FXgwhMx-HuYBWiao8WhugjwOIoQYIpQh1FmDMcfCe04hEoIBCp0NNZfucCtuD9alGvTamRybVb7Vuu2AnACeAJ5sTrq6LsfFd7ksAE-b7odecAMpJz0k3Hpm-h6Q6V6j2vO9GAfI-Hq-AcwPFJ0N9wjIeL6cfvz6gEbHTYclATJ-6BL1bXxS339O6vV8U_9m1fPLDfH2emqfXq7Xz82cqksVkPGA7WdsU6Td3sO6hp0LQOESdfhfVL_6g4fEfwMAAP__LO-SNw)
---
My friend, you know the truth:
---
* These charges are an attempt to criminalize investigative journalism.
* These charges are an attempt to distract from what our reporting exposed as insecure elections in Minnesota.
* These charges are now the basis for a landmark 1st Amendment case where everyone’s right to speak truth to power is on the line.

---
Here’s what REALLY happened in Hennepin County.
---
* >> We never applied for a ballot.
* >> We talked to election clerks, asking questions and getting answers so that Americans could know what was really happening in the elections.
* >> We never signed an affidavit, procured a ballot, or even touched a ballot.

---
Even the Soros-funded prosecutor admitted we never intended to vote. So, where’s the crime? There is no crime. **This is about prosecuting and persecuting citizen journalists. It’s intimidation pure and simple.** Well my friend, I’m not backing down. **[And I need to know right away if you’ll help fight this fight as long as necessary... through whatever trial and appeals are necessary... all the way to the Supreme Court if needs be.](https://email.editor.goppresidential.com/c/eJyckUtu2zAQQE9D7STwT2nBhVtZQYs6MbJwlwTFj0JUJAWKdq5fqE0ukO3DzOA9zO-LuuiwhrQ86-jkkrdNlV3Nzufiwrte_4RUs8n3UnNK-aEwxLxFqEVMaVPDwymqGyup5pRz3jiJxEAFgwTR5k0ypPVgPTW9FXgwhMx-HuYBWiao8WhugjwOIoQYIpQh1FmDMcfCe04hEoIBCp0NNZfucCtuD9alGvTamRybVb7Vuu2AnACeAJ5sTrq6LsfFd7ksAE-b7odecAMpJz0k3Hpm-h6Q6V6j2vO9GAfI-Hq-AcwPFJ0N9wjIeL6cfvz6gEbHTYclATJ-6BL1bXxS339O6vV8U_9m1fPLDfH2emqfXq7Xz82cqksVkPGA7WdsU6Td3sO6hp0LQOESdfhfVL_6g4fEfwMAAP__LO-SNw)** Because a court battle like this takes resources. We started with $0 in our bank account, and we built this movement from the ground up without a dime from the greedy corporations hurting all of us. I am so proud that this campaign is fueled by working people. But that does mean we have to keep asking for your support until this race is officially over. I wouldn’t ask if it wasn’t so important. We’re amplifying good candidates who are passionate about protecting civil rights, making life affordable, and leaving a better world for future generations. The midterms are coming up, and we can’t do this work without you. With your support, we'll work to halt the right-wing agenda and support strong Democrats who will fight for us across the country. A recent news item caught my eye: A team of scientists at the [UK Atomic Energy Authority and the University of Bristol](https://substack.com/redirect/b4e7a8ac-a101-4a38-a93e-9f269d81cac2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) managed to build a battery out of nuclear waste and synthetic diamond that will be producing power through the year 7700. That's not a typo. The group successfully placed Carbon-14, the radioactive isotope extracted from retired nuclear reactor graphite, in a manufactured diamond to [capture the electrons from the carbon decay](https://substack.com/redirect/39735671-7a14-44f3-90c7-35044386c33e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) the way a solar panel captures photons. As the diamond captures the radiation, it also produces a trickle of clean electricity that should flow for 5,700 years.
The irony is that nuclear waste, the bane of the last energy revolution, might actually fuel the next one. The UK alone has roughly [95,000 tonnes of irradiated graphite](https://substack.com/redirect/215c7836-8c8d-4c59-b388-b1a7ba36e5e7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) sitting in storage, waste from early reactors. It's classified as intermediate-level nuclear waste, costing taxpayers millions per year to babysit. That waste will remain radioactive for tens of thousands of years. Thinking of it as waste implies it's a long term liability. Thinking of it as fuel, however, turns it into an asset and potential revenue stream. The nuclear age's biggest headache has the potential to become its most elegant asset.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/3088de9b-244a-4328-b5b7-1b0d63d6cdf7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Now, before you dump all your energy stocks, it's worth thinking about the scale of this development. This battery produces **micro** watts, not megawatts. You're not charging a Tesla with it. You're not powering a grid. What you _are_ powering is a pacemaker that never needs replacing, a deep-sea sensor that outlasts the civilization that deployed it, a spacecraft transmitter that's still talking when Voyager 1's [plutonium runs dry around 2036](https://substack.com/redirect/39735671-7a14-44f3-90c7-35044386c33e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). The Swiss are working on a [parallel track](https://substack.com/redirect/e22d5569-6926-41c4-9e23-829dee9f73d3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), solid-state crystalline electrolytes that could push conventional battery lifespans to 30 years with thousands of deep cycles. Between Zurich and Bristol, the entire concept of "battery life" is being reimagined...not _more_ power, but power that lasts _longer_.
And then there's fusion, at the other extreme. In December 2022, Lawrence Livermore's National Ignition Facility got [more energy out of a fusion reaction than its lasers put in](https://substack.com/redirect/a0ada204-0698-40e5-aff2-c3fa766a134a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), a historic first. It has since [repeated the feat](https://substack.com/redirect/655f4096-d373-4196-96bd-23ee0c94684b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg); a [record shot last year](https://substack.com/redirect/d8fd88f5-6d01-44c9-9403-528347d81dc4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) yielded roughly four times the energy delivered to the target. Private capital has noticed. Commonwealth Fusion Systems has [raised some $4 billion](https://substack.com/redirect/76c6f450-8755-4a64-9045-b35b6074a4b2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and its SPARC machine is about 80% built, targeting net energy in 2027. Helion, which has a contract to sell fusion power to Microsoft, [hit 150 million degrees in February](https://substack.com/redirect/0978e5f7-ec43-45d7-a922-1393a74e876a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Pacific Fusion and dozens of others are also in the race. The old joke was that fusion is always 30 years away. Nobody's laughing now. Humanity appears well on the path to bottling the power of star.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/701bbb13-9df2-4804-9c58-2b00e4b0260c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
What I find most thought-provoking are the implications of all of this. How would the world be different if energy was infinite and the problem of energy storage was truly solved?
I've spent the last several months writing about a series of crises that, on the surface, look unrelated. I wrote about how conflict in the Strait of Hormuz [took 20% of the world's LNG offline](https://substack.com/redirect/37a58f85-109c-4b30-8241-aa31c68e7995?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and left New England staring at $441-per-megawatt-hour electricity prices. I wrote about how [record diesel](https://substack.com/redirect/37a58f85-109c-4b30-8241-aa31c68e7995?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) prices fed an inflation spiral that forced the Fed to hike instead of cut. I wrote about how that inflation, compounded by tariffs, produced the [voter rage that flipped both chambers of Congress](https://substack.com/redirect/37a58f85-109c-4b30-8241-aa31c68e7995?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and ended unified Republican government.
Every one of those crises traces back to the same root: energy dependence. Dependence on fossil fuels that move through chokepoints. Dependence on supply chains that can be severed by a single missile. Dependence on molecules that have to be drilled, shipped, refined, and burned, and that give the countries sitting on top of them leverage over everyone else.
* * *

Proponents note the world is safer without Maduro, the world's leading supporter of narcoterrorism, and the IRGC, the world's largest exporter of terrorism (a sentiment with which I agree). Opponents suggest these actions were brazen violations of sovereignty and will destabilize the world.](https://substack.com/redirect/8625a339-3de3-48df-a078-d63dc26170ee?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

* * *
Now imagine a different reality. If energy storage were solved (not in the microwatt sense of a diamond battery, but in the principle it represents: durable, decentralized, unchokeable power ), the entire problematic connection of energy to peach unravels. Hormuz becomes a shipping lane, not a geopolitical weapon. Diesel prices decouple from Middle Eastern wars. The Fed sets rates based on the economy, not on the price of crude. And the political rage that just reshaped Congress? It doesn't have the fuel (pun intended!) to ignite.
I'm not suggesting a carbon-14 diamond battery is going to do all that. It's a microwatt device in a lab in Bristol. But what it represents (the transformation of waste into power and in so doing removing the constraints of depletion) is trajectory that, followed far enough, dissolves the assumptions underneath every crisis I've written about this year.

* * *
It may also dissolve one more assumption. We've spent trillions on climate mitigation (subsidies, carbon taxes, mandates, net-zero pledges), all premised on clean energy staying scarce and expensive. What if it becomes abundant? Twenty-five years from now, will we look back on today's efforts as prudent insurance, or as stockpiling whale oil on the eve of kerosene? Will our grandchildren thank us for the sacrifice, or wonder why we rationed what was about to become abundant? Or is the promise of a miracle the most dangerous excuse to do nothing? Carbon already emitted doesn't care what we invent in 2040. With limitless energy, couldn't we simply pull it back out of the sky?
Energy is destiny. It always has been. Wars are fought over it. Elections are won and lost on its price. Empires have been relegated to the dustbin of history because of having or being denied energy. Entire economies rise and fall on who controls the spigot. A battery that lasts 5,700 years doesn't change that tomorrow. But it whispers something that the oil markets, the defense contractors, and the petrostates don't want to hear.
The spigot won't matter forever.

Carbon already emitted doesn't care what we invent in 2040. With limitless energy, couldn't we simply pull it back out of the sky? Energy is destiny. It always has been. Wars are fought over it. Elections are won and lost on its price. Empires have been relegated to the dustbin of history because of having or being denied energy. Entire economies rise and fall on who controls the spigot. A battery that lasts 5,700 years doesn't change that tomorrow. But it whispers something that the oil markets, the defense contractors, and the petrostates don't want to hear. ### How Three Decades of Retreat Produced the Missing Christian Electorate
| | [Heartland Journal ®](https://substack.com/@heartlandjournal)
